Place slices in the air fryer basket, working in batches so they don’t overlap while air frying.
Air fry at 380 degrees F for 10-12 minutes until bacon is crispy. Remove slices and place on a cooling rack or on a plate to cool before eating.
3beecb40a352563319ce2402.title: Air Fryer Candied Bacon

3c1a64b00aca39f47db0be2b.author: Becky
instructions: Rinse the jalapeno peppers and pat dry, then slice in half. Remove stems, membrane, and seeds, then set aside.
In a medium bowl, combine the cheddar and cream cheese. Generously spoon the cream cheese mixture into one of the halves of the jalapeno and then place two halves together.

Divide the pork sausage into six even portions. Flatten a portion of the sausage and fold around a jalapeno, pinch meat to completely seal and cover jalapeno, while shaping into an oval egg shape. Repeat until all jalapenos are covered with sausage.
Wrap each covered jalapeno with two slices of bacon, wrapping each piece of bacon with tight wrap, securing with toothpicks.
Place in the air fryer basket and air fry at 380 for 15-17 minutes until sausage reaches an internal temperature of 160 degrees F and bacon is crispy. Use a meat thermometer to confirm doneness.
Using a basting brush or spoon, brush egg with barbecue sauce before serving.
3c1a64b00aca39f47db0be2b.title: Air Fryer Armadillo Eggs

3cf5d09caeda3977102c941a.author: Becky
instructions: If starting with a frozen duck, let it defrost in the refrigerator for 24 to 48 hours. Once the duck is thawed, remove the neck and any giblets that may be inside the duck. Rinse, and pat dry with paper towels. Let the duck sit until the seasonings are ready.
In a small mixing bowl, combine all of the seasonings together. Lightly brush the olive oil all over the duck and then coat with the seasonings.
Transfer the duck, breast side up, to the air fryer basket and air fry for at 300 degrees Fahrenheit, 45-55 minutes.
Do not tie the legs during the cooking process, as they need to move freely so the juices and fat can drain from the duck.
The duck should have an internal temperature of 170 degrees F in the thickest part of the duck breast.
Once that temperature is reached, let the duck rest for about 10 minutes before carving.
3cf5d09caeda3977102c941a.title: Air Fryer Duck

3d13c95aac0e377a1413168a.title: Air Fryer Garlic Butter Hasselback Potatoes

3d214720292305d84549a694.author: Becky
instructions: To make these peeps, begin by unrolling and separating each crescent roll.
Place one peep at the end of the crescent toll and roll until it is completely wrapped. Be sure to pinch any exposed parts of the peep.
Spray basket with nonstick cooking spray, or line with air fryer parchment paper. Place wrapped peeps in the prepared basket, leaving a small space in between peeps.
Air fry peeps at 350 degrees for about 5 minutes, until crescent rolls are golden brown
Carefully remove them from the Air fryer. Sprinkle with powdered sugar, drizzle with chocolate syrup or frosting glaze.
3d214720292305d84549a694.title: Air Fried Marshmallow Peeps

3dfe298b91779477bd246322.author: Bibi
3dfe298b91779477bd246322.title: Bacon-Wrapped Stuffed Chicken Breasts in the Air Fryer

3e0b2b5758fecd593bd4fb22.author: Jen
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon olive oil spray (or nonstick cooking spray)
instructions: Spray each ramekin or dish you will be using with olive oil spray.
Crack an egg into each dish (one egg per dish).
Place ramekins in the air fryer basket.
Air fry the eggs for 5 minutes at 370°F.
Make sure the egg white is firm and solid.  *5 minutes should make a nice runny egg yolk. If you want a firm yolk, add 1-2 minutes to the cooking process until you get your preferred doneness.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
3e0b2b5758fecd593bd4fb22.title: Air Fryer Fried Eggs

3ebad70715e5cd3ce0bbed7d.author: Becky
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the sugar and cinnamon, stirring together. Set cinnamon sugar mixture aside.
Lay tortillas flat, and then brush the top of each tortilla with melted butter.
Sprinkle cinnamon sugar over tortillas until well coated. Use a pizza cutter and slice tortillas into triangles.
Place them in a single layer into the air fryer basket lined with a sheet of parchment paper.
Air fry at 350 degrees F for 6-8 minutes, or until they reach desired crispness. Shake basket halfway through the cooking process.
Remove chips and place them on a wire rack to cool and remain crispy.
3ebad70715e5cd3ce0bbed7d.title: Air Fryer Cinnamon Sugar Tortilla Chips

402d5f145e3ab05ab18235b2.author: Becky
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the butter, sugar, and brown sugar and beat together for about 1-2 minutes.
Add in the eggs, vanilla, and lemon juice. Continue mixing until the ingredients have combined, scraping the sides of the bowl if necessary.
Slowly add in the flour, oats, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon until a soft dough forms.
Stir in the chocolate chips and the walnuts, until they are well combined into the dough.
Using a small scoop, or medium spoon, drop dough into the air fryer basket, lined with parchment paper with small holes for venting.
Cook at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 7 minutes, until the cookies are golden brown and no longer doughy on bottom.
Allow the cookies to cool for about a minute in the basket, so they can set enough to be lifted with a spatula.
402d5f145e3ab05ab18235b2.title: Air Fryer DoubleTree Signature Cookie (Copycat)

408b6c80535c6a4f7b0a7478.author: Diana Moutsopoulos
ingredients: 4 ounces imitation crab meat, finely chopped
3 tablespoons finely chopped scallion, plus more thinly sliced for garnish
Sweet chili sauce, for brushing and serving
instructions: Stir together crab meat, cream cheese, scallion, Sriracha, salt, Worcestershire sauce, sugar, and garlic in a medium bowl until well combined. Spoon mixture into a large piping bag or resealable plastic bag. Cut a 1-inch hole in tip or corner. Set aside.

Place beaten eggs on a large rimmed plate. Dip both sides of 1 rice paper sheet in egg until it becomes slightly pliable, then remove, letting excess drip off. Place rice paper sheet on a clean work surface or plate.

Pipe a 5-inch line (about 4 teaspoons) of crab mixture across the bottom 1/4 of rice paper sheet, stopping about 1 inch from sides. Starting from bottom of sheet, roll rice paper, jelly roll style, over crab mixture. Place roll seam side down. Starting with one end, loosely roll up into a spiral; tuck free end underneath to secure. (If rice paper isn’t pliable enough yet, let it sit a few seconds until softened before spiraling.) Repeat with remaining egg, rice paper sheets, and crab mixture. Brush tops with remaining beaten egg, then discard excess. Sprinkle tops of rolls with sesame seeds.

Preheat a 6-quart air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C) for 5 minutes. Lightly coat air fryer basket with cooking spray. Add rice paper rolls to basket, spacing 1 inch apart; spray tops with cooking spray. Cook until golden and crispy, 12 to 15 minutes.
Transfer rolls to a serving plate. Brush with chili sauce, if desired, and garnish with scallions. Serve immediately with more chili sauce.  Recipe developed by Tricia Manzanero Stuedeman
408b6c80535c6a4f7b0a7478.title: Crispy Air Fryer Crab Rangoon Rolls

40a06e1a64c29365caec81ab.author: Becky
instructions: Pat the frog legs dry with paper towels. Brush with oil and then place into a gallon-sized resealable plastic bag bag.
Stir together flour, baking powder, paprika, onion powder, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.

Once combined, pour the flour mixture into the bag and add legs in flour mixture. Seal bag, and then coat frog legs by tossing until they are covered with the spice mixture. Lightly spray the basket with cooking spray, or brush a light coating of olive oil over the basket to prevent the legs from sticking.
Place floured frog legs in an Air Fryer basket without overlapping or stacking. To get extra crispy air-fried frog legs with the deep fryer flavor, spray tops with cooking spray.
Working in batches, air fry at 400 degrees F for 8-10 minutes. Flip halfway through the cooking time.
Cooked frog legs are suggested to have 160° degrees internal temperature, and are golden brown, remove from the Air Fryer and serve immediately.
40a06e1a64c29365caec81ab.title: Air Fryer Frog Legs

40f4aec94755d3d79008336a.author: Becky
instructions: To make the egg roll filling, use a large skillet, on medium-high heat, and brown the ground pork. Stir together until the pork is cooked, about 3-5 minutes.

Keep the skillet on medium heat, combine sesame oil, onions, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, cabbage, and carrots. Continue stirring until the vegetables begin to soften, and all of the ingredients are well combined, about 3-5 minutes. Remove from heat and let mixture slightly cool before trying to wrap them.
On a flat surface, lay out wrappers with corners left and right. Fill the center of the wonton with a large spoonful or two of the cabbage the filling.

Fold bottom corn over the filling and tuck under. Next, fold in the left and right corners, and then turn over, (rolling like a burrito) to make a large pillow shape. Dip you one or two fingers in water, or use a pastry brush, and then trace the wrapper with water, just on the outer edges, so when you fold them, they will seal.
Lightly spray the air fryer basket with nonstick cooking spray, and place each rolls in air fryer, in a single layer, without stacking or overlapping.
Air fry at 400 degrees F for 5-8 minutes, until golden brown and crispy. Flip halfway during the air frying process.
40f4aec94755d3d79008336a.title: Air Fryer Egg Rolls

423b14fc624a343153f5d89c.author: Becky
instructions: After removing the shells, rinse the shrimp and pat them dry. Place them in a large bowl, and set aside.
In a small microwave safe bowl, combine the butter and minced garlic, and microwave for about 30 seconds, until the butter has melted.
Pour the butter and garlic mixture over the shrimp, and stir together, coating the shrimp with the mixture.
Pour the shrimp into the basket, leaving enough room between them so they aren't stacked.
Air fry at 370 degrees Fahrenheit for 6-8 minutes, tossing halfway through.
To determine doneness, the base of the shrimp tail will be an opaque color, and no longer translucent.
423b14fc624a343153f5d89c.title: Air Fryer Garlic Butter Shrimp

instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 375°F (190°C) for 3 minutes.
Divide the pizza dough into equal portions. Roll each one into a small, round shape on a lightly floured surface.
On one half of the dough round, spread pizza sauce, a generous handful of shredded mozzarella, pepperoni, and a sprinkle of Italian seasoning.
Fold the dough over to form a half moon shape. Pinch the edges firmly to seal. You can use a fork to crimp the edges.
Brush the outside of each calzone with olive oil.

Place the calzones in the air fryer basket, making sure they don’t touch. Air fry at 375°F (190°C) for 7–10 minutes, flipping halfway through. After flipping, brush the tops again with a little more olive oil and finish cooking.
Remove from the air fryer and let cool slightly. Serve hot!
42537301ed6c49e393104c70.title: Air Fryer Calzones

437704768e1eda6bdba9ac0e.author: Natalie Gravois
ingredients: 2 14.5 ounce cans quartered artichoke hearts, drained
instructions: Place drained artichokes in a bowl and drizzle with melted butter. Gently toss to coat.
In a separate bowl combine breadcrumbs, grated cheese, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spray the air fryer basket with avocado oil spray.
Working in batches, gently coat artichoke quarters with breadcrumb mixture. Space out artichoke quarters in the airfryer basket.
Air fry artichokes at 400 degrees F (200 degrees C) until golden brown, 6 to 8 minutes. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve with aioli.
437704768e1eda6bdba9ac0e.title: Air Fryer Crispy Artichoke Hearts

439043523cecabd9d7d25a28.author: Becky
ingredients: ¼ cup egg whites, whisked (about 2 large egg whites)
instructions: Use shallow bowls to create a dredging station by adding egg whites into one shallow bowl and make breadcrumb mixture with Italian seasoning, and ground black pepper into the other shallow bowl. Set both bowls aside.
Pat pork chops dry with paper towels on a cutting board or baking sheet.
Dip each pork chop  into the egg whites, and then into the breading mixture until each piece is fully coated.
Place the breaded pork chops on a baking sheet or clean plate until all pieces  have been breaded.
Prepare the air fryer basket with air fryer safe cooking spray, then place the pork chops in a single layer to allow room for the air to circulate and even cooking.

Very lightly spray the tops of the pork chops with olive oil spray. Air fry at 380 degrees F for 8-10 minutes, flipping and spraying cutlets with cooking spray again halfway through the cooking process for maximum crispiness.
Check the internal temperature of the pork with a meat thermometer. Temperature should be 145 degrees F.
Remove from the basket when they are cooked through and golden brown. Place them on a wire rack to remain crispy.
439043523cecabd9d7d25a28.title: Air Fryer Breaded Pork Chops

43a3205f55fdc0417f4a875e.author: Pat Bernitt
ingredients: 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard, or to taste
instructions: Spread mayonnaise on one side of each slice of bread. With mayo side down, lightly spread 4 slices of bread with Dijon mustard, evenly top each with Swiss cheese, ham slices, folded to fit, and pickle slices. Place the remaining 4 bread slices on the sandwiches, mayo side up, and lightly press sandwiches to close.
Preheat the air fryer to 380 degrees F (193 degrees C). Spray the air fryer basket with cooking spray or line with a parchment liner.
Place sandwiches in the air fryer basket in a single layer, leaving some space around them. You may have to cook the sandwiches in batches, depending on the size of your fryer.
Cook until sandwiches begin to brown, 3 to 4 minutes. Flip, and cook until cheese has melted and sandwiches are golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes more. Slice sandwiches in half and serve warm.
43a3205f55fdc0417f4a875e.title: Air Fryer Grilled Ham and Cheese

4441e705d7c34d2463b13faf.author: Becky
instructions: Pat the drumsticks dry with a paper towel, then brush with a light coating of olive oil. Place the drumsticks in a large Ziploc bag
In a small bowl, stir together the flour, baking powder, paprika, salt, pepper, and onion powder. Shake the bag until the drumsticks are covered with the spice mixture.
Lightly spray the basket with cooking spray, or brush a light coating of olive oil over basket to prevent drumsticks from sticking.
Transfer the drumsticks from the bag to the air fryer basket, placing them in a single layer, without overlapping or stacking.
Air fry at 400 degrees F for 20 minutes. Flip chicken drumsticks halfway through the cooking time.

Chicken will be done when it is golden brown and crispy, and when an instant read meat thermometer reaches an internal temperature of 175° F. The chicken drumsticks are safe to eat at 165°F, but cooking them a bit longer is recommended to fully tenderize dark meat.
4441e705d7c34d2463b13faf.title: Air Fryer Chicken Drumsticks

4464d5e6e044a9550c5278d3.author: lutzflcat
4464d5e6e044a9550c5278d3.title: Air Fryer Tilapia with Fresh Lemon Pepper

4764e47cd5b5ba3751d515cf.author: Becky
ingredients: 1 can store-bought pizza dough (13.8 ounces or two cans of thin crust pizza 8 ounces each)
instructions: Open the can of premade pizza dough and on a lightly floured surface, roll it out into a rectangle.
With a pizza cutter or kitchen knife cut the dough into twelve 1-inch strips, and then fold each strip in half. Tie each piece into dough knots, making 12 knots.
Place the dough balls into the air fryer basket in a single layer, lined with parchment paper, a silicone baking mat or lightly sprayed with olive oil spray.
Air fry at 350 degrees F for 8-10 minutes, until they are golden brown.
While knots are in a small mixing bowl, stir together the melted butter, parmesan cheese, garlic, parsley flakes, and Italian seasoning.
When knots are golden brown, use a pastry brush and generously brush garlic butter on each piece with butter and seasonings and top with grated parmesan cheese.
4764e47cd5b5ba3751d515cf.title: Air Fryer Garlic Knots

476d5ffc3fd3a4cef05edfb5.author: Jen
ingredients: 8 pieces bacon (thinly sliced, cut into thirds.)
instructions: Peel the shrimp and set them aside in a single layer onto a baking sheet.
Sprinkle a small amount of Old Bay Seasoning over the peeled shrimp.
Cut the bacon pieces into thirds. Carefully wrap the bacon around the shrimp, taking care to tuck the bacon under the bottom of the shrimp.
Prepare the basket of the air fryer with olive oil or with a nonstick cooking spray.
Add the bacon wrapped shrimp to the basket of the air fryer. Take care to keep the bacon edge tucked under the shrimp.
Cook on 390 degrees for 9-10 minutes, or until fully cooked.
Carefully remove the shrimp from the air fryer and serve immediately.
476d5ffc3fd3a4cef05edfb5.title: Air Fryer Bacon Wrapped Shrimp

instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C) for 3 minutes.
Cut the chicken breast into bite sized pieces.
Toss the chicken bites in the olive oil and coat the chicken evenly with poultry seasoning, garlic powder, ground black pepper, and paprika.
Place in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Cook at 400°F (200°C) for 8 minutes, tossing halfway through.
Remove when cooked through and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C) and serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
479d98aea76a7b53447818d2.title: Juicy Air Fryer Chicken Bites

480f29b8b6b429b495cffe04.title: The Best Air Fryer French Fries

483ba0da2739c479aecf2fe8.author: Becky
ingredients: ½ cup  Italian seasoned bread crumbs
instructions: Prepare the Air Fryer basket with nonstick cooking spray. Set aside.
Whisk the eggs in a medium shallow bowl. Set aside.
In another medium shallow bowl, combine the breadcrumbs, flour, parmesan cheese and seasonings.
Rinse and pat dry the eggplant, then cut into slices, about ¼ inch in thickness.
Dredge each slice of eggplant into the whisked eggs, then into the flour and breadcrumb mixture.
Place each piece in the prepared air fryer basket, without stacking or overlapping pieces.
Air fry at 370 degrees F for 16-18 minutes. Flip slices halfway through air frying. Slices should be crisp and golden brown.

When eggplant slices are golden and crispy, leave them in the air fryer basket. Spread a small spoonful of marinara sauce on top of each piece. Then evenly sprinkle mozzarella cheese, (about 1-2 teaspoons) on top of the sauce.
Return basket to air fryer and air fry at 370 degrees F for an additional 1-2 minutes, until cheese topping is melted.
483ba0da2739c479aecf2fe8.title: Air Fryer Eggplant Parmesan

4891fedd2a776eab28f43ae8.author: Jeanine Donofrio, Phoebe Moore
4891fedd2a776eab28f43ae8.title: Air Fryer Corn on the Cob

4a1cfb9677fc50d024cb7189.author: France Cevallos
ingredients: 1 (14 ounce) can quartered artichoke hearts in water, drained
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 390 degrees F (200 degrees C). Pat artichoke hearts dry with a paper towel to remove excess moisture.
Combine artichoke hearts, Parmesan, Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, and garlic powder in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat. Place into the air fryer basket.
Cook in the preheated air fryer for 4 minutes. Shake the basket and continue to cook until artichokes begin to brown and the edges are crispy, 3 to 4 minutes more. Serve immediately.
4a1cfb9677fc50d024cb7189.title: Air Fryer Artichoke Hearts

4aea2d326aeee7652b904c0a.author: Becky
instructions: Open packing and place pizza in the air fryer basket.
Air fry at 380 degrees F for 6-8 minutes, until crispy.
4aea2d326aeee7652b904c0a.title: Air Fryer Frozen Pizza

4aef82b64c3024f4d90d35ee.author: Jen
ingredients: 1 teaspoon avocado oil (in a spray bottle)
instructions: Slice the avocado. Cook the bacon.
Top a wrapper with a teaspoon of shredded cheese.
Add a slice of avocado to the wrapper and cheese.
Add a slice of bacon, folded, onto the cheese and avocado slice.
Add water to the edges of the wrapper and then carefully wrap the avocado and bacon egg roll.
Add the egg rolls in a single layer into the air fryer basket. Spray the tops with avocado oil.
Air fry the avocado bacon egg rolls at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 9- 10 minutes.
Carefully remove from the basket of the air fryer before serving.
4aef82b64c3024f4d90d35ee.title: Air Fryer Avocado Bacon Egg Rolls

4b2f6c2c94cec42bf9f629a8.author: Julia
ingredients: 1 ¼ cups rotisserie chicken (cut into cubes)
instructions: Spread some Ranch dressing over your tortilla.
Layer the shredded rotisserie chicken and chopped bacon over it.
Top with a generous sprinkle of shredded cheese.
Place another tortilla on the top to cover it.
Brush butter on the top of the tortilla and carefully transfer to the Air Fryer basket.
Air fry at 350 degrees for 6-8 minutes or until golden brown and crispy.
4b2f6c2c94cec42bf9f629a8.title: Air Fryer Chicken Bacon Ranch Quesadillas

4c234fef3e969c6b294087d8.author: Becky
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 380° F. If you don't have a preheat option, let your air fryer run on 380 degrees F for 3-5 minutes.
Prepare the hens by patting them dry with a paper towel. Remove any giblets package that may be inside the hens. (They usually are already removed.)
Brush the hens with olive oil, coating both sides, then sprinkle the poultry seasoning and salt and pepper, also on both sides of the hens.
Place hens breast side down in the preheated air fryer basket.

Air fry the hens at 380 degrees Fahrenheit for 15 minutes. Then flip to the other side, and and air fry for an additional 10-15 minutes. Use a meat thermometer to confirm the internal temperature reaches 165 degrees F.
Let the hens rest for 5-10 minutes in their own juices before slicing and serving.
4c234fef3e969c6b294087d8.title: Air Fryer Cornish Hen Recipe

4c3a3f66afbbf68db61f1ffa.author: Soup Loving Nicole
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Place veal on a clean work surface and sprinkle with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.

Place flour in a flat dish. Beat egg and parsley together in a second dish. Place bread crumbs in a third dish. Dredge each veal cutlet first in flour, then in egg-parsley mixture, followed by bread crumbs, pressing down so that bread crumbs adhere.
Spray the basket of the air fryer with nonstick cooking spray. Place breaded veal cutlets into the basket, making sure not to overcrowd. Spray the tops with nonstick cooking spray.
Cook for 5 minutes. Flip, spray any chalky spots with nonstick cooking spray, and cook for 5 minutes longer. Repeat with remaining veal. Serve with lemon wedges.
4c3a3f66afbbf68db61f1ffa.title: Air Fryer Wiener Schnitzel

4c923b7f5c2bf87e2d708bbe.author: Jen
instructions: Use a paper towel to pat dry the chicken breasts.
Add the chicken breasts to a large resealable bag.
Add the olive oil and seasonings to the bag with the chicken breasts. Seal and gently toss the bag to coat the chicken evenly with the olive oil and seasonings.
Coat the basket of the air fryer with cooking spray or parchment paper if needed.
Place the seasoned chicken breasts into the air fryer basket in a single layer.
Air fry the chicken breasts at 390 degrees Fahrenheit for 20 minutes, flipping the chicken breasts halfway through the cooking time.
Use a digital meat thermometer and make sure the chicken has reached an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully remove and allow chicken breasts to rest for 5 minutes before serving.
4c923b7f5c2bf87e2d708bbe.title: Air Fryer Grilled Chicken Breast

4d5cb867bfaa5bcca0c2b708.author: Taylerand20
ingredients: kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
0.5 teaspoon garlic powder, or to taste
0.5 teaspoon dried parsley, or to taste
instructions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Rub potatoes with olive oil and season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and parsley. Place potatoes in the air fryer basket.
Cook in the preheated air fryer until potatoes are soft, 40 to 50 minutes, depending on potato size.
Slice potatoes lengthwise. Pinch both sides of each potato, using your hands and forcing potatoes to open, until the fluffy insides start to come out. Add 1 tablespoon of butter into each potato.
4d5cb867bfaa5bcca0c2b708.title: Easy Air Fryer Baked Potatoes

4d907e1316174864c37d5c9b.author: Jen
ingredients: ½ cup shredded Cheddar Jack cheese
instructions: To make this recipe, begin by rinsing and then cutting the potatoes into wedges, leaving the potato skin on.
Add the cut potatoes to a medium bowl, and cover with cold water. Let them soak in the cold water for 25-30 minutes. This will remove the starch and makes them crispy.

Once they have soaked, drain the water and pat the sliced potatoes dry with paper towels. Return them to the bowl. 4. Coat potatoes with a tablespoon olive oil, paprika, salt, garlic powder, and pepper. Mix until coated evenly.
Place the seasoned potato wedges into a single layer in the air fryer basket, without overlapping.
Air fry the potatoes at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 20-23 minutes
During the cooking process, shake the basket at the 10 minute mark. If you have larger wedges, you may need to add 2-3 extra minutes for cooking time.
Open the basket and sprinkle the cheese onto the potato wedges. Air fry the cheese covered potatoes at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and starting to golden.
Remove the cheesy potatoes from the basket with a spatula and serve with ranch dipping sauce.
4d907e1316174864c37d5c9b.title: Air Fryer Cheesy Potatoes

4de24334aa748d950d0e3108.author: Becky
ingredients: 4  dill pickles (cut into slices or spears)
instructions: Begin by drain pickles from pickle juice. Slice pickles, then pat pickles dry with a paper towel.

Using three small to medium bowls for your breading station, preferably a shallow bowl. In one bowl add flour. The second bowl, add beaten eggs. In the third bowl, combine the bread crumbs, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir together.
Dip each pickle in the flour mixture, shaking off excess flour. Next, dip chips in egg mixture, and finally into the breadcrumb mixture, giving it a light coating. Gently tap off excess crumbs.
Place the coated pickle slices in air fryer basket that has been lightly sprayed with oil or lined with parchment paper.
Air fry pickles at 380ºF for 7-10 minutes, turning the pickles halfway through air frying process. Pickles will be crispy and golden brown.
4de24334aa748d950d0e3108.title: Air Fryer Fried Pickles

4e7adfba71646ae201654a21.author: Becky
instructions: Using Jiffy Cornbread Mix
Add Jiffy mix, milk, and egg to a bowl.
Stir just until combined.
Fill the baking dish with the cornbread batter.
Preheat air fryer for 2-3 minutes at 320°F.
Place in the air fryer basket, then cook at 320° F for 20 minutes, until golden brown on top.
From Scratch
Using a medium bowl, combine the flour, cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt. Stir the dry ingredients together.
Next, add in the buttermilk, melted butter, and egg. Then continue to stir the ingredients together into a thick batter.
Fill the baking dish with the cornbread batter.
Preheat air fryer for 2-3 minutes at 350°F.
Place in the air fryer basket, then cook at 350°F for 13-15 minutes, until golden brown on top.
Make Cornbread Muffins

Mix as directed for either method. Transfer batter to silicone liners, filling 1/3 full. Preheat air fryer at 350°F for 2-3 minutes. Add muffins to air fryer basket and cook for 10 minutes. Makes about 9 muffins.
4e7adfba71646ae201654a21.title: Air Fryer Cornbread

4f142e0a9092d313ba4708cf.author: Jackie
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon paprika, plus more for garnish
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Whisk together milk and egg in a bowl until combined. In a large bowl, stir together flour, salt, cayenne pepper, paprika, black pepper, oregano, thyme, and cumin.

Slice 1 inch off the top of the onion and remove papery skin. Remove a 1-inch-diameter core from the middle of the onion, using an apple corer or paring knife, leaving the very bottom of the root end intact. Use a large sharp knife to slice about three-fourths of the way down center of the onion; turn onion 90 degrees and slice again. Keep slicing each section in half until you have 16 sections, being careful not to cut through the bottom of the onion. Spread sections apart.

Dip onion into milk mixture and then into flour mixture to coat, separating the petals and sprinkling flour mixture between them. Dip onion into milk mixture again, then into flour mixture to coat once more. Coat onion with cooking spray.
Arrange onion in the air fryer basket. Cook until crispy, 20 to 25 minutes.
Stir together mayonnaise, horseradish sauce, ketchup, paprika, salt, dried oregano, cayenne pepper, and black pepper in a small bowl. Chill until blooming onion is ready.
Serve blooming onion with dipping sauce and garnish with additional paprika.
4f142e0a9092d313ba4708cf.title: Air Fryer Blooming Onion

4fc92da89f7c3d25d0956f61.author: Becky
instructions: Begin by washing and drying the apples. After they are dried, use the mandolin, or a sharp knife, and cut them into thin slices, about 1/8 inch thick.
Sprinkle a tsp of cinnamon on the apple slices and place them in the air fryer basket, in a single layer.
Once they are in the basket, set the temperature to 380 degrees F with a cook time of 8-10 minutes.
Turn the slices at the 5 minute mark. Let the slices sit for at least 5 minutes to crisp. (15-30 minutes rest time is best.)
4fc92da89f7c3d25d0956f61.title: Air Fryer Apple Chips

501b8f86eced37008c24d396.author: Jen
instructions: Remove the corn dogs from the freezer.
Take a slice of bacon and carefully wrap the entire corn dog.
Place the bacon wrapped corn dogs in a single layer into the basket of the air fryer.
Air fry the corn dogs at 370 degrees Fahrenheit for 9-10 minutes, or until the bacon is cooked and crispy.
Carefully remove the corn dogs from the air fryer basket and serve them on a plate with your favorite dipping sauce.
501b8f86eced37008c24d396.title: Air Fryer Bacon Wrapped Corn Dogs

504e0dcbbaedca03da856956.author: Becky
instructions: To make these cupcakes, prepare the box mix according to directions. For Betty Crocker Cake Mix, use a large mixing bowl, or stand mixer, combine the cake mix with eggs, oil, and water.
Beat or whisk cake batter, until the ingredients are well combined. Batter should be smooth and creamy.

Lightly spray the inside of the silicone cupcake holders with non-stick spray, then place them in the air fryer basket. If using a basket air fryer, you need to use silicone muffin cups. (If using muffin tins, you can use paper liners.)
Pour the cupcake batter in the liners, filling them about 3/4 of the way full. Do not overfill or the fan can splatter the batter.
Air fry cupcakes at 350 degrees F for 10-12 minutes. Allow cupcakes to cool before frosting.
504e0dcbbaedca03da856956.title: Air Fryer Cupcakes

5052476f9acfa9e343d00aaf.author: Becky
instructions: Remove the wrapper and wax packaging around each piece of cheese, then set into the freezer for at least an hour. Don't skip this step.
Make three separate dipping stations using shallow bowls. In the first bowl, add the flour. In a second bowl, whisk the eggs together. And in the third bowl, add the breadcrumbs.
Dip cheese into the flour, until lightly coated. Next, dip the coated cheese into the whisked eggs. You want to make sure it’s coated enough with whisked egg so the coating will stick.

Finally, dip the cheese into the breadcrumbs, until well coated. Repeat until all cheese rounds are coated. You can double dip into the breadcrumbs to make sure they are well coated so the cheese doesn’t melt out.
Lightly spritz both sides of cheese with olive oil spray and then place in an air fryer basket, without touching or overlapping. (You may have to work in batches.)
Air fry at 380 degrees F for 4-6 minutes, turning halfway through air frying, until the coating is golden brown. Remove from the air fryer and eat while warm.
5052476f9acfa9e343d00aaf.title: Air Fried Babybel Cheese

5085c7db5a256e8cf8414857.author: France Cevallos
ingredients: 7.5 ounces garden vegetable cream cheese (such as Philadelphia®)
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 390 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Fill each jalapeño half with cream cheese and wrap with a halved bacon strip. Tuck in bacon ends or use toothpicks to secure.
Place jalapeño poppers inside the air fryer basket, working in batches to avoid overcrowding if necessary.
Cook in the preheated air fryer until bacon is done to your liking, 10 to 12 minutes. Keep poppers warm in an oven on the lowest setting while air-frying the remaining poppers.
5085c7db5a256e8cf8414857.title: Keto Air Fryer Jalapeño Poppers

52389f67ca0a142acdf2b8cd.author: Lisa Bryan
52389f67ca0a142acdf2b8cd.title: Air Fryer Salmon Bites (Lemon Garlic Butter)

52e078cb24596eedb2a151d3.author: Becky
instructions: Trim the ends of the asparagus stalks, about one to two inches.
Rinse the freshly cut asparagus.
Lightly brush the asparagus with olive oil.
Cut bacon slices in half, then wrap a slice of bacon around two or three stalks of asparagus
Place the asparagus in the basket of the air fryer.
Cook at 370° Fahrenheit for 12-14 minutes, depending on  bacon crispness your prefer.
52e078cb24596eedb2a151d3.title: Air Fryer Bacon Wrapped Asparagus

53115f8bbce9c96d82940012.author: Yoly
ingredients: 1 tablespoon confectioners' sugar, or to taste
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Line the air fryer basket with parchment paper. Spray parchment paper with cooking spray.
Mix pancake mix and water together in a bowl until well combined.
Dip each cookie into pancake mixture and place in the prepared basket, making sure they are not touching; cook in batches if necessary.
Cook in the preheated air fryer for 4 to 5 minutes; flip cookies and cook until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes more.
Remove from air fryer and place on cooling rack.
Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar.
53115f8bbce9c96d82940012.title: Air Fryer Oreos

531aa2986ba16edc53a8da3e.author: Becky
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the garlic, paprika, salt, and pepper. Then set aside.
Remove any green leaves around the stem, trimming if necessary. Do not remove the stem.
Place the cauliflower on the top of a cutting board, so the stem is on the bottom.
Using a sharp knife, carefully slice the cauliflower into pieces about ½ an inch slices, until you have three or four steaks.
Remove any excess cauliflower pieces that have come apart during the cutting, and set aside.
Brush both sides of the cauliflower slices with olive oil, and then sprinkle the spice mixture on both sides.
Place steaks in the air fryer basket. Air fry at 400 degrees F for 8-10 minutes until they are golden brown and tender.
531aa2986ba16edc53a8da3e.title: Air Fryer Cauliflower Steaks

53768aca2896540fb04a8b03.author: Jen
ingredients: 2  salmon filets (6 ounces each, skin removed)
1 tbsp fresh lime juice (1-2 limes, squeezed)
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400°F/200 C. Spray the basket of the air fryer with nonstick cooking spray.
Use a paper towel to pat the salmon filets dry. Cut the filets into 1 inch squares.
In a medium bowl combine olive oil, garlic powder, cayenne pepper, smoked paprika, sea salt, ground pepper, and oregano.
Pour the blackened seasoning mixture over the salmon bites and gently toss to coat.

Place the salmon bites in a single llayer in the basket of the air fryer. Make sure to leave space between each piece for the air to evenly circulate. Air fry for 4-5 minutes. Flip and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes of cook time, or until the salmon reaches an internal temperature of 140-145°F.
Place the cooked salmon in a bowl.
Sprinkle the salmon bites with lime juice before serving.
Serve over rice, serve over a salad, or serve as fish tacos.
53768aca2896540fb04a8b03.title: Air Fryer Blackened Salmon Bites

56cbe61861ab032c8387fd47.author: Becky
ingredients: 1 cup frozen mixed vegetables (like peas, carrots, and corn)
instructions: In a medium pan, over medium-high heat, use a wooden spoon to break up and brown the ground beef, then drain the grease through a strainer.
Transfer ground beef mixture to a medium bowl, then add in onion, mixed vegetables, and Italian seasoning, salt and black pepper. Stir together to fully combine, then set aside.
Roll out empanada dough on a cutting board and cut circles, about 5-6 inches in diameter. Use a cookie cutter, pastry cutter or biscuit cutter if needed to make the dough rounds the same size.
Spoon a small amount of the seasoned ground beef mixture onto one side of the circle. Fold dough over the meat filling, sealing in the mixture, then pinch, or use a fork to seal edges.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg and a tablespoon of water. Use a pastry brush and brush the top of each empanada with egg wash.
Place them in the air fryer basket, in a single layer on parchment paper liner, or spritzed with olive oil spray. Air fry at 350 degrees F for 8-10 minutes, until the dough is golden brown.
56cbe61861ab032c8387fd47.title: Air Fryer Empanadas

instructions: Preheat the Air Fryer to 380 degrees Fahrenheit. Prepare the basket with nonstick spray once the Air Fryer has completed the preheat cycle.
Slice the chicken and all vegetables into slices. Add the slices to a medium sized mixing bowl and top with fajita seasoning.
Add the seasoning chicken and vegetables to the prepared Air Fryer basket and cook at 380 degrees Fahrenheit for 18 minutes. Toss the chicken and vegetables every few minutes to ensure even cooking.
Remove the chicken and vegetables from the Air Fryer and serve with flour tortillas, cheese, and your favorite fajita toppings.
56fa265571e7eceb2031cae4.title: Air Fryer Chicken Fajitas

577d1e54e306f7d3a67c370b.author: Natalie Rizzo, M.S., RD
577d1e54e306f7d3a67c370b.title: Air-Fryer Zucchini Noodle Hash with Eggs

57871dc225031ebf595abfd6.author: Becky
ingredients: 1 teaspooon ranch seasoning (or seasoning of choice)
instructions: Pour the can of chickpeas into a strainer, then drain chickpeas and rinse them well under cold water. Pat chickpeas dry with a clean kitchen towel or paper towels.
Place chickpeas in a medium bowl with oil and toss them until they are well coated. Add in your choice of seasonings and toss them together fully coating the chickpeas.
Pour chickpeas into the air fryer basket in a single layer, leaving space between chickpeas so they cook evenly.
Air fry at 400 degrees F for 13-15 minutes, until they are crispy and a light golden brown.
Serve seasoned chickpeas at any temperature.
Homemade Ranch Seasoning
In a small bowl combine dried parsley, dried dill, garlic powder, onion powder, salt and ground black pepper.
57871dc225031ebf595abfd6.title: Air Fryer Chickpeas

57db454d4f226681b952b8bf.author: Becky
instructions: In a small bowl, add the sugar and cinnamon. Stir together to combine, and then set aside.

Open the can of crescent rolls and unroll the sheet of dough. Use a pastry brush and brush the melted butter on top of the pastry sheet. Evenly sprinkle half of the cinnamon sugar mixture over the top of the sheet of dough.
Fold the dough in half, lengthwise, pinching ends together to seal in the cinnamon and sugar. Cut dough into 10-12 evenly sized strips.
Twist each strip and gently pinch the ends of each strip together.
Next brush each twisted strip with the melted butter, and then evenly sprinkle with remaining sugar and cinnamon mixture.
Place in the air fryer basket, that is lightly sprayed with non-stick cooking spray, or lined with air fryer parchment paper in a single layer.
Air fry at 350 degrees F for 5-7 minutes, until golden brown. Serve warm by itself or a yummy dipping sauce.
57db454d4f226681b952b8bf.title: Air Fryer Cinnamon Twists

5808be29e1b3e5171ffad5d2.author: Becky
instructions: Place the chicken strips in a medium bowl and toss with olive oil, coating each piece of chicken.
Sprinkle chili powder, cayenne pepper, paprika, salt and pepper over the coated chicken. Toss the chicken in the bowl until the seasonings have evenly covered each piece of chicken.
Place the chicken in the air fryer basket, spread out so they aren't overlapping or stacked.
Cook at 380 degrees F for 12 minutes, flipping chicken tenders halfway through cooking.
5808be29e1b3e5171ffad5d2.title: Air Fryer Blackened Chicken Tenders

587256781797e92c96b2a018.author: Jen
instructions: Prepare the ramekins with nonstick cooking spray and set aside.
Add the egg, milk, and Jiffy corn muffin mix to a small bowl. Mix until combined.
Scoop the chili into the bottom of the ramekin, filling them a little over halfway.
Top the chili with the corn muffin mixture.
Place the chili pot pies into the basket of the air fryer.
Use the air fry feature and cook for 12-15 minutes at 320 degrees Fahrenheit, or until the corn muffin topping is golden brown and fully cooked.
Carefully remove the ramekins from the air fryer and serve.
587256781797e92c96b2a018.title: Air Fryer Chili Pot Pie

598e5769758518ba9e42f56f.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat the Air Fryer to 360 degrees Fahrenheit.
Prepare the Air Fryer basket with non stick cooking spray, use a dish, or use parchment paper.
Place the cinnamon roll dough in the Air Fryer basket, leaving a little space in between each cinnamon roll.
Set the cooking time for 8 minutes to allow the cinnamon rolls to fully cook. If you want to tops to be a little crispier, consider adding an additional minute to the cook time.
Remove the cinnamon rolls from the Air Fryer and top them with the icing while they are still hot. Serve immediately.
598e5769758518ba9e42f56f.title: Air Fryer Cinnamon Rolls

5ac1901bc882ca762787b2de.author: France Cevallos
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 360 degrees F (180 degrees C).
Combine blueberries, flour, lemon juice, and salt in a small bowl. Toss to coat, then divide the mixture between two 1-cup ramekins.
Combine oats, flour, brown sugar, and cinnamon for the topping in a small bowl. Mix in softened butter using a fork until mixture is crumbly. Sprinkle over the blueberries.
Place the ramekins in the air fryer basket and cook until the blueberries are warmed throughout and topping is golden brown, 12 to 14 minutes.
5ac1901bc882ca762787b2de.title: Air Fryer Blueberry Crisp

5b8f0b45fa2e20268c257b70.author: Diana Moutsopoulos
ingredients: 1 (17.3 oz.) pkg. thawed, frozen puff pastry (2 sheets)
1 1/2 cups store-bought lemon curd (such as Bonne Maman or Mackay’s)
2 Tbsp. blueberry jam (such as Stonewall Kitchen)
instructions: Unfold puff pastry sheets and cut each into 9 (3-inch) squares.

Working in batches, place in an even layer of puff pastry squares in the air fryer basket, ensuring pastry squares are not touching; chill any remaining cut puff pastry squares in the refrigerator uncovered.

Cook in the air fryer at 325 degrees F (162 degrees c) until puffed and golden, 12 to 14 minutes. Set on a wire rack to cool completely, about 10 minutes. Repeat process with remaining cut 'donuts' (=puff pastry squares).

Place lemon curd in a piping bag fitted with a medium round tip (such as Wilton 9). Insert tip of a pairing knife into the side of each cooled donut, piercing halfway through the donut. Pipe lemon curd through the hole until donut feels slightly heavier, about 4 teaspoons per 'donut'. Make sure not to overfill. Place 'donuts' on a wire rack.

Whisk sugar, jam, and 2 tablespoons of the milk together in a large, shallow bowl until smooth; add remaining 1 tablespoon milk, 1 teaspoon at a time, until glaze has a dippable consistency. Dip each filled donut into the glaze, shaking off any excess before returning to the wire rack. Serve immediately or let stand until glaze is set, about 30 minutes. Recipe developed by Melissa Gray-Streett
5b8f0b45fa2e20268c257b70.title: Lemon Blueberry Air Fryer Puff Pastry 'Donuts'

5bb310218341b8aecfbcecfd.author: Lindsay Ostrom
5bb310218341b8aecfbcecfd.title: Ridiculously Good Air Fryer Chicken Breast

5c599b2ec388f43a1728449f.author: Becky
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour (plus more for kneading the dough)
⅓ cup unsalted butter (cut into slices)
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, and salt. Use a fork to mix together, and then add in slices of butter. Continue mixing until the butter is flaky.
Add buttermilk to the mixture, and slowly stir together until a soft dough forms.
Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface. Knead for 2-3 minutes until the dough is smooth. Roll the dough until it is about ¾ inches in thickness.
Use a biscuit cutter to cut the dough into round shapes.
Lightly spray the air fryer basket with non stick spray, or a brush of olive oil. Place biscuit cutouts into the air fryer basket, without stacking or overlapping.
Brush the tops of each biscuit with milk and then air fry at 350 for 8-10 minutes, until the dough is golden on top.
5c599b2ec388f43a1728449f.title: Air Fryer Biscuits (From Scratch)

5d55e185dfbaff73e23bf1b2.author: Laura Rege
5d55e185dfbaff73e23bf1b2.title: Air Fryer Poached Egg Avocado Smash Toast

5dd8b2e3e1b652d1f30f50c8.author: Jen
instructions: Place frozen breadsticks in air fryer in a single layer in the prepared air fryer basket.
Make sure to keep ample space (about an inch) between each breadstick during the cooking process so they cook evenly.
Air fry breadsticks at 340 degrees F for 8-10 minutes, until crispy and they get to your preferred texture.
Serve while hot.
5dd8b2e3e1b652d1f30f50c8.title: Air Fryer Frozen Breadsticks

instructions: Make the instant banana pudding and allow it to set for approximately 5 minutes.
Unroll the pie crust on a flat surface and cut the dough for the mini pies.
Add 2 teaspoons of banana pudding and 3-4 banana slices to the pie crust.
Fold over the pie crusts and crimp the edges with a fork or with a hand pie gadget. Do this for each pie.
Spray the basket of the air fryer with nonstick spray, olive oil spray, or use a piece of parchment paper to prevent sticking.
Add the banana pudding pies in a single layer in the air fryer basket.
Brush the tops of the pies with the egg and air fry for 3 minutes at 380 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully flip the banana pies and brush with egg, then air fry for an additional 3 minutes.
Remove from the air fryer basket and serve with whipped cream and additional banana slices.
5f36d10c7df54ec01dcd8b11.title: Air Fried Banana Pudding Pie

instructions: Add the chicken nuggets and tater tots to the Air Fryer and cook on 400 degrees Fahrenheit/200 degrees C for 6 minutes.
While the chicken and tots are cooking, add the eggs and milk to a small bowl and whisk until fully combined.
Once the chicken and tots are finished cooking, chop them into small bite-sized pieces.
Pour the egg mixture into a 7" baking dish, then top the egg mixture with the nuggets and tots.
Decrease the heat on the Air Fryer to 350 degrees F and add the springform or small baking pan to the Air Fryer. Cook for 7 minutes.
Open the air fryer basket and use a fork to scramble and mix things up. Cook for an additional 3 minutes.
Open the Air Fryer basket and top the breakfast bowl with the shredded cheese. Air fry for an additional minute.
Remove from the Air Fryer and garnish with salt and pepper to taste and any other additional toppings you might like to add.
60271737ef0c2cccefa39a15.title: Air Fryer Breakfast Bowl

6028ede1ca9f5167865008b4.title: Air Fryer Burst Tomato Burrata Caprese Salad

605143977fbeeb04a5553c88.author: Laura Rege
605143977fbeeb04a5553c88.title: Air Fryer GF Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies

605bccbef2e3bd4200a0a177.author: Ashley Lamego
instructions: Using a sharp knife, carefully cut corn in half vertically. Cut those halves again vertically. Finally cut each quarter in half horizontally.
Combine olive oil, lemon juice, smoked paprika, chili powder, cumin, parsley, steak seasoning, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Add corn to marinade and toss to coat.
Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Line the air fryer basket with parchment paper.
Add corn ribs and cook for 12 to 14 minutes. You might need to cook them in batches.
Stir together sour cream, hot sauce, lemon juice, salt, chili powder, and cumin in a small bowl. Serve with corn ribs for dipping.
605bccbef2e3bd4200a0a177.title: Air Fryer Corn Ribs with Zesty Sour Cream

61018c93120d437a0f9d551b.author: Yoly
61018c93120d437a0f9d551b.title: Air Fryer Mac and Cheese Balls

625977dbec89c4471426b77d.author: Laura Rege
625977dbec89c4471426b77d.title: Air Fryer Roasted Butternut Squash & Kale Salad with Balsamic-Maple Dressing

628e51af73e573a7e383768c.author: Yoly
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 380 degrees F (190 degrees C).

Cut the top off the head of garlic and place on a square piece of aluminum foil. Bring the foil up and around garlic. Pour olive oil on top and season with salt and pepper. Close ends of foil over garlic, creating a pouch.
Air fry until garlic is soft, 16 to 20 minutes. Open the foil pouch very carefully, as hot steam will escape.
628e51af73e573a7e383768c.title: Air Fryer Roasted Garlic

647a776177efc1064e44b99c.author: Marisel Salazar
647a776177efc1064e44b99c.title: Pollo Campero-Style Air Fryer Fried Chicken

651ed4125d42ecdf07a1132f.author: Becky
instructions: To make this air fryer recipe, transfer broccoli to a large bowl. Then, toss with olive oil.
Once broccoli is coated with oil, sprinkle in seasonings. Toss broccoli with garlic powder, salt, and pepper and continue to toss until broccoli is evenly coated.
Transfer broccoli in air fryer basket in a single layer without overlapping.
Air fry frozen broccoli at 380 degrees F for 8-10 minutes, shake basket halfway through cook time. Air fry until roasted broccoli reaches your personal preference level of crispness.
651ed4125d42ecdf07a1132f.title: Air Fryer Frozen Broccoli

654fb4ba45b0000d4c64351f.author: Becky
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the oats, raisins, brown sugar, walnuts, and cinnamon. Stir in the melted butter until the ingredients are combined. Set the bowl aside to prepare the apples.
Cut the tops of the apple off along with the stem. Then, cut a small part of the bottom of the apple as well, so it stands up without shifting or rolling.

Use an apple corer, melon baller or paring knife to scoop out the apple core and remove all seeds.  Spoon the mixture into the cored apples until they are filled. Place the filled apples into the air fryer basket.
Air fry apples at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 8 to 10 minutes until the apples reach your desired softness. Let apples cool just enough to remove from basket, and serve warm.
654fb4ba45b0000d4c64351f.title: Air Fryer Baked Apples

65cb3cc43cd40e3e0ec0b127.author: Becky
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 350 degrees F.
Add the flour to a small shallow bowl. In a small shallow second bowl, whisk the eggs. In a third small bowl, combine panko bread crumbs with the garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Dip cheese curds in the flour, lightly shake off excess coating of flour, then dip into the eggs to coat cheese curds, and then finally dredge through the panko and seasonings.
Lightly spray the basket with nonstick cooking spray. Then place the cheese curds in air fryer basket, in a single layer, without stacking or overlapping.

To make sure you get a crispy coating, spritz the curds with olive oil spray-or avocado oil. (Any remaining coated curds that won't fit in air fryer basket, place on a small baking sheet and keep in the refrigerator until ready to air fry.) Air fry at 350 degrees F for 3-4 minutes, then turn curds and air fryer for an additional 3-4 minutes, until golden brown and crispy.
65cb3cc43cd40e3e0ec0b127.title: Air Fryer Cheese Curds

6605b35a2ddaf7d7304375e2.author: Becky
ingredients: toppings (optional: Salsa, Shredded Cheese, Crumbled Bacon, Hot Sauce)
instructions: Line the air fryer basket with parchment paper and set aside.
Slice avocado in half, lengthwise, and then carefully remove the pit.
Using a spoon, gently remove some of the avocado meat, forming a well where the pit was. Save the removed avocado to top the egg, or to eat separately.
Place halves in the air fryer basket, and then carefully crack eggs, breaking direction into each half of the avocado.
Air fry at 400 degrees F for 8-12 minutes, depending on how well done you prefer your eggs.
Season as desired.
6605b35a2ddaf7d7304375e2.title: Air Fryer Avocado Eggs

6684eb70a5236aae40aaca3f.author: Yoly
ingredients: 2 teaspoons dry Italian-style salad dressing mix
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Gather all ingredients.
Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Wash and dry potatoes. Trim edges to make a flat surface on both ends.
Combine extra-virgin olive oil and salad dressing mix in a large bowl. Add potatoes and toss until potatoes are well coated.
Place in a single layer into the air fryer basket. Cook in batches if necessary.
Air fry until potatoes are golden brown, 5 to 7 minutes. Flip potatoes and air fry for an additional 2 to 3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
6684eb70a5236aae40aaca3f.title: Air Fryer Roasted Potatoes

678382dfaac9ed764e340c6d.author: Becky
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the butter, cream cheese and sugar, mixing on medium to high speed until the batter is smooth and creamy.
Add in eggs and vanilla, continuing to mix until combined.
Slowly add in the flour and baking powder until it forms into a thicker batter.
Stir in chocolate chips, making sure they are evenly mixed into the batter.
Pour the batter into a lightly sprayed Bundt pan that will fit in your air fryer basket.
Cook on 350 Fahrenheit for 15-18 minutes.
678382dfaac9ed764e340c6d.title: Air Fryer Chocolate Chip Pound Cake

67c894e33620c74e3219f388.author: Natalie Rizzo, M.S., RD
67c894e33620c74e3219f388.title: Air-Fryer Stuffed Potatoes with Lentil Stew

680f57a4e11d4d6d59a1d3c9.author: Paul Tannos
ingredients: 0.75 teaspoon Himalayan pink salt, or to taste
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 325 to 350 degrees F (165 to 175 degrees C) according to manufacturer's instructions.
Stir water and 3/4 teaspoon pink salt together in a small bowl until salt mostly dissolved.
Place almonds in a medium bowl; stir in salt water until coated. Transfer almonds to the air fryer basket.
Bake in the preheated air fryer for 6 to 7 minutes. Stir almonds, return to the air fryer, air fry until almonds turn brown inside, 5 to 6 minutes more.
Return almonds to same mixing bowl; stir in olive oil and salt until completely coated. Allow to cool before serving,
680f57a4e11d4d6d59a1d3c9.title: Air Fryer Roasted Almonds

68a464933660d101aa939433.author: Soup Loving Nicole
ingredients: 2 (6 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
instructions: Mix paprika, thyme, cumin, cayenne, onion powder, black pepper, and salt together in a bowl; transfer to a large plate.
Preheat the air fryer to 360 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Rub oil over each chicken breast until fully coated, then press into spice mixture until all sides are coated. Let sit for 5 minutes while the air fryer preheats. Place into the air fryer basket.

Air-fry chicken until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 20 minutes, flipping halfway through. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
Transfer chicken to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
68a464933660d101aa939433.title: Air Fryer Blackened Chicken Breasts

68b00ee776c0ea6d8c402a87.author: Becky
instructions: In a large bowl, to gnocchi with olive oil, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, and salt, until all pieces are well coated.
Pour gnocchi into the air fryer basket, spread evenly.
Air fry at 380 degrees F for 13-15 minutes, tossing gnocchi 2-3 times during the air frying process.
Serve with marinara sauce and garnish with parsley flakes and parm cheese.
68b00ee776c0ea6d8c402a87.title: Air Fryer Gnocchi

6938ab0842383ff9a5b0e7b6.author: Megan Ginsberg
6938ab0842383ff9a5b0e7b6.title: Air-Fryer Cider Pork Chops with Apples

698a3276b126d58b3fcc18eb.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 365 degrees F.
In a large bowl, combine the chicken, egg, cheese, onion, panko crumbs, garlic, salt and pepper. Mix chicken mixture together with your hands until fully combined.
Divide the chicken mixture into 4 equal parts and shape them into 5-inch diameter burgers.
Spray the air fryer basket with non-stick cooking spray and place the chicken patties in air fryer in a single layer.
Air fry the chicken burgers at 365 degrees F for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through, depending on the thickness of the patties.
Use a meat thermometer to confirm internal temperature of burger patties which should be a safe temperature of 165 degrees F.
Allow chicken burgers to cool for a couple of minutes then carefully remove them from the basket.
Serve while hot or let them continue to rest on a baking rack.
698a3276b126d58b3fcc18eb.title: Air Fryer Chicken Burgers

698caad48431477e74931fb9.author: Becky
instructions: If not already, peel off outer shell and remove shrimp tails, then devein shrimp (gently cut down the back of shrimp and remove black vein). Then gently rinse shrimp. Place on paper towels to absorb moisture.
Add shrimp to a large bowl, and toss with oil and seasoning blend until evenly coated.
Place prepared shrimp in the air fryer basket, without stacking, and air fry at 370 degrees F for 8 minutes. While cooking shrimp, shake the basket halfway through for even cooking.
Serve immediately while hot.
698caad48431477e74931fb9.title: Air Fryer Cajun Shrimp

69f30db3f3567d1ab5e36d92.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat the Air Fryer to 380 degrees Fahrenheit. Prepare the Air Fryer basket with olive oil spray, nonstick cooking spray, or parchment paper AFTER you've preheated the Air Fryer.
Rinse and completely dry the chicken wings.
Mix the garlic powder and brown sugar together and use as a dry rub over the wings. For extra crispy wings, add a pinch of baking powder to the seasoning before coating the wings.
Place the wings in a single layer in the basket of the air fryer.

Cook the wings at 380 degrees Fahrenheit for 16 minutes, flipping the ings every 4 minutes. Increase the heat to 400 degrees Fahrenheit and cook for an additional 4 minutes. Use a meat thermometer to ensure the wings have reached 165 degrees Fahrenheit. Add 1-2 minutes time if needed.
Remove the chicken wings from the air fryer and place them into a medium sized mixing bowl. Cover the wings with BBQ sauce and then toss the wings until they are completely coated in sauce.
Serve with your favorite sides and dipping sauces.
69f30db3f3567d1ab5e36d92.title: Air Fryer BBQ Chicken Wings

6b60b6e602be8a66aa1c3fcb.author: Becky
instructions: Add yeast to a bowl with water that is warm.  Let the yeast sit in the warm water for about 3 to 5 minutes.
Once the yeast has activated, add in the flour, sugar, milk, butter, and salt. Gently fold the ingredients together until they were well combined and it becomes slightly flaky.
Turn the dough onto a floured surface and knead the dough until it is smooth, then shape it into a ball.
Place the ball of dough into the air fryer basket, and then wrap with plastic wrap or a clean kitchen towel. Allow the dough to rest until it doubles in size, about 30 minutes.
Brush the top of the loaf with an egg wash. and air fry at 320 degrees Fahrenheit for 8 to 10 minutes, until the top of the bread is golden brown.
6b60b6e602be8a66aa1c3fcb.title: Air Fryer Bread Recipe

6d01b5a8f662a13f408082af.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse and pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel. Place the chicken in a small bowl and toss in the olive oil.
Add the seasonings to the chicken thighs and make sure to cover them evenly.
Place the thighs into the air fryer basket in a single layer.
Air Fry at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 15 minutes of cooking time. Flip the chicken thighs and cook for an additional 8 minutes.
Use a meat thermometer to ensure the thighs have reached an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
For a crispier skin, cook for an additional 1-2 minutes before serving.
6d01b5a8f662a13f408082af.title: Air Fryer Chicken Thighs

6d6ea6b3d94e66c9309c25f5.author: Becky
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground meat, breadcrumbs, feta cheese, garlic, parsley, dill, oregano, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Add the egg, then mix until well combined. Be careful not to overwork the mixture to keep the meatballs tender.
Roll the mixture into small, bite-sized meatballs (about 1 inch in diameter). You should get about 18-20 meatballs.
Preheat your air fryer to 380 degrees F for 3-5 minutes. Then place the meatballs in a single layer in the air fryer basket, avoiding overcrowding. Cook in batches if needed.
Air fry for 10-12 minutes, shaking halfway through, until the meatballs are golden brown and cooked through. The internal temperature should reach 160 degrees F for turkey or 165 degrees F for lamb.
6d6ea6b3d94e66c9309c25f5.title: Air Fryer Greek Meatballs

6ded0ae38f7aff9f2ddad101.author: Jen
instructions: Remove the puff pastry and from the freezer and allow it to sit at room temperature for 30 minutes. Allow the cream cheese to soften at room temperature for 30 minutes. Melt the butter.
Cut the puff pastry and cream cheese into equal-sized squares.

Place the cream cheese into the center of the puff pastry squares. Fold the corner over to the opposite corner to create a triangle with the pastry. Pinch the edges with a fork. Repeat for all of the squares.
Place the cream cheese puff pastries into the air fryer basket in a single layer. Brush the pastries with the melted butter.
Air fry at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 12-15 minutes, or until the pastries are golden brown.
Carefully remove from the air fryer and serve with honey.
6ded0ae38f7aff9f2ddad101.title: Air Fryer Cream Cheese Puff Pastry

6df7c8076675eb1797b014e2.author: Jen
instructions: Add the flour and baking powder to a large bowl and set aside.
In a medium sized mixing bowl, cream together the white sugar, brown sugar, and butter with a hand mixer.
Add the egg and the vanilla extract to the butter mixture.
Pour the butter and sugar mixture into the flour mixture and mix until combined.
Fold the mashed bananas into the muffin batter.
Use a large cookie scoop or ice cream scoop to scoop the batter into the silicone baking molds. Fill each mold ¾ of the way full.
Place the silicone molds into the basket of the air fryer and bake at 350 degrees Fahrenheit with the bake function for 10 minutes.
Carefully remove the silicone molds from the basket and place them on a cooling rack.
6df7c8076675eb1797b014e2.title: Air Fryer Banana Muffins

6e2fc3e866bb03a8f98eae8c.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat the Air Fryer to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the crescent rolls from the can and lay them out on a flat surface.
Carefully wrap one Oreo into each crescent roll sheet.
Once the air fryer is ready, prepare the basket with oil or with a sheet or parchment paper.
Add the wrapped Oreos onto the air fryer basket in a single layer, keep room in between for them to cook.
Cook on 325 degrees Fahrenheit for 5-6 minutes, or the tops have turned until golden brown.
Allow the fried Oreos to cool for a minute before removing them from the basket.
Sprinkle the fried Oreos with a little powdered sugar and serve immediately.
6e2fc3e866bb03a8f98eae8c.title: Air Fried Oreos

6fd7ac4efae1aaa070875392.author: Becky
instructions: If the chicken breast is not already sliced, cut the pieces of chicken into strips, then place the pieces of chicken into a medium bowl.
In a medium bowl, toss the chicken pieces with the chili powder, salt and pepper. Stir them until the seasonings have coated each piece.
Lightly spray the air fryer basket with cooking spray, or line with air fryer parchment paper. Then place the seasoned chicken in air fryer basket, in a single layer, without overlapping.

Air fry at 380 degrees Fahrenheit for five minutes. Flip chicken over and then continue cooking them for an additional five minutes. Chicken should be golden brown and have an internal temperature of 165 degrees F if using a digital cooking thermometer.
Top tortillas or taco shells with chicken and then your favorite taco toppings.
6fd7ac4efae1aaa070875392.title: Air Fryer Chicken Street Tacos

6febaaf241f588006191381f.author: Becky
instructions: Slice half of a loaf of bread lengthwise. Then cut bread into evenly sized slices. If you are going to use the entire loaf, work in batches as they fit in your air fryer basket, or on your air fryer trays.
To make the garlic butter, use a small bowl, combine butter, minced garlic, and parsley flakes. Stir together to evenly distribute the ingredients into the butter.
Use a bread knife to spread butter mixture on each slice of bread.
Place slices of bread in the air fryer basket and air fry at 370 degrees Fahrenheit for 4-6 minutes, until toast is golden and crispy.
6febaaf241f588006191381f.title: Air Fryer Garlic Bread

ingredients: 4-6 pieces bread ((allow it to sit out for 2-3 hours before using))
instructions: Mix the cinnamon and sugar together in a small bowl or plate and set aside.
Stack the bread and then use a serated knife to cut the slices into thirds.
Whisk the eggs together and pour them into a rimmed plate.
Dip the bread pieces into the egg and then dip into the cinnamon and sugar.
Place the bread into the prepared Air Fryer basket in a single layer with an inch or two between slices.
Air Fryer the bread pieces for 8-9 minutes on 370 degrees Fahrenheit, flipping them halfway through.
Remove from the Air Fryer and serve immediately.
7047faaf74e17e07d92effdf.title: Air Fryer French Toast Sticks

707dd4830ec4f62d8f342bb8.author: Becky
instructions: Preheat your air fryer to 350°F
Open can and remove dough. Unroll and then gently pull apart the triangles where they have been pre-cut.
Roll each triangle from the widest end to the tip, creating a crescent shape. (Don't roll too tightly or they won't be able to expand while air frying.)
Lightly spray the air fryer basket or tray with non-cooking spray or oil.
Place the crescent rolls in air fryer, leaving some space between each one.
Air fry at 350 degrees F for 6-8 minutes, or until the rolls are golden brown and crispy. Remove the crescent rolls from the air fryer and allow them to cool for a few minutes before serving.
707dd4830ec4f62d8f342bb8.title: Air Fryer Crescent Rolls

ingredients: 1 box Pre Made Pie Crusts ((2 crusts))
instructions: To begin, unfold the pie crust. Use a rolling pin to flatten it out if necessary.
Place one pie crust circle into the bottom of the pie plate, lightly pressing it down. Then, pour the apple filling over the crust, and spread it evenly.
Top with the second crust and trim excess edges. Cut a few slits in the top of the pie to release steam while it's cooking.
In a microwave safe bowl, melt the butter, then brush the top of the crust with the melted butter. You can also use an egg wash to help the pie turn golden while it's cooking.

Combine the sugar and cinnamon together, and sprinkle a dash of the cinnamon sugar on top and place in the air fryer basket. Use the air fry feature and cook at 320 degrees F for about 18-23 minutes. The pie crust should be golden brown on top, and cooked on the bottom.
Once it is done cooking, you can sprinkle a little bit of brown sugar, white sugar, powdered sugar, or another dash of the cinnamon and sugar mixture.
Serve chilled or warm, topped with ice cream or whipping cream.
714a83577d6bae46d0ade3ce.title: Air Fryer Apple Pie

71d57360756ed647daac3e73.author: aigerekairfryer
instructions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat an air fryer to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
To make the meatloaf: Stir breadcrumbs and milk together in a medium bowl and let sit for 5 minutes. Add beef, onion, egg, thyme, salt, and pepper; stir to combine evenly without overmixing.
Meanwhile, form beef mixture into 2 (3- x 4 1/2-inch) rectangles.
To make the glaze: Stir ketchup, vinegar, brown sugar, and Worcestershire sauce together in a small bowl and set aside.

Spray air fryer basket generously with cooking spray or line with parchment paper for easier clean up. Add meatloaves to basket and spray generously with cooking spray. Roast in the preheated air fryer until nicely browned, about 20 to 25 minutes, brushing evenly with ketchup mixture after 18 minutes of cooking. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 155 degrees F (68 degrees C).
Remove meatloaf from basket; let rest for 5 minutes. Garnish with thyme leaves and serve. Enjoy!
71d57360756ed647daac3e73.title: Air Fryer Meatloaf

72265cbc305d42094fc30401.author: Nicole Russell
ingredients: 1 (12 ounce) jar mild banana peppers, drained
ranch or creamy Italian salad dressing for dipping
instructions: Combine flour, garlic powder, paprika, and pepper in a large resealable plastic bag. Seal and shake to combine.
Add drained banana peppers to the bag in batches, shaking to coat in between.
Preheat an air fryer to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C) for 5 minutes. Spray basket with nonstick cooking spray.
Place flour-coated pepper rings in a single layer in the basket of the air fryer (this may need to be done in batches). Spray tops with nonstick cooking spray.
Cook for 4 minutes. Shake basket and cook for 4 minutes more.
Using tongs, transfer pepper slices to a serving plate. Serve with ranch or creamy Italian dressing for dipping.
72265cbc305d42094fc30401.title: Air Fryer Banana Peppers

7375aec3ae335a2e1009f51d.author: Jen
instructions: Set the puff pastry from the freezer for 30 minutes, or long enough to be able to manipulate the frozen pastry easily.
Cut the puff pastries in half.
Scoop 1-2 tablespoons of the apple pie filling into the puff pastry.
Fold the pastry from one corner to the opposite corner, making a triangle.
Seal the edges of the puff pastry with a fork or pinch the edges with your fingers.
Brush the tops of the pastry with egg white.
Place the apple turnovers into the air fryer basket in a single layer.
Air fry the apple turnovers at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 6-8 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Serve warm.
7375aec3ae335a2e1009f51d.title: Air Fryer Apple Turnover

74373a1acb0f18c56fc06c7f.author: Jen
instructions: Clean and pat dry the shrimp.
Add panko bread crumbs, flour, and seasonings to a medium bowl. Mix well.
In a small mixing bowl, add egg to the milk and whisk until combined.
Dip the shrimp into the flour and panko mixture, the egg mixture, and then back into the flour mixture. Place on a wire rack.
Chill the breaded shrimp in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C).

Arrange shrimp in a single layer in the preheated basket, spray lightly with olive oil, and air fry for 5 minutes. Flip the shrimp after 5 minutes, spray again, and cook for 3-5 minutes until golden and crispy.
While the shrimp are cooking, make the spicy sauce. Add the mayo, chili garlic sauce, and rice vinegar to a small bowl. Mix well until thoroughly combined. Set aside.
Toss the cooked shrimp in the sauce until well-coated and serve.
74373a1acb0f18c56fc06c7f.title: Air Fryer Bang Bang Shrimp

744c9b4a77c59d0b3c8dbc0f.author: Becky
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Prepare your air fryer basket or air fryer tray if needed.

Unroll one cinnamon rolls, and then refold it in layers, zig-zagging into a tree shape. (You can use a toothpick once done to help it hold it's shape while air frying, just don't forget to remove it before frosting!) Repeat until all trees are shaped.
Lightly spray the air fryer basket with olive oil or nonstick cooking spray, or line with parchment paper, then, place the shaped trees into the basket of the air fryer.
Air fry the trees at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 4-6 minutes, until golden brown.
Carefully remove the basket from the air fryer and allow the trees to cool for a minute before removing them from the air fryer basket.
While the trees are cooling, add the food coloring to the original icing glaze or a tub of cream cheese frosting and stir until well mixed.
Once the trees are cooled, frost the top of the trees with green icing and then add the sprinkles. Top the trees with a large star candy or sprinkle and serve while warm.
744c9b4a77c59d0b3c8dbc0f.title: Air Fryer Christmas Tree Cinnamon Rolls

7586b2b90e3149bad192070f.author: fabeveryday
instructions: Gather all ingredients. Heat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
To make the dipping sauce: Mix mayonnaise and sriracha sauce together in a small bowl until well combined. Refrigerate until ready to serve.
Drain pickles and dry them on paper towels.
Mix egg and milk together in a bowl. Mix flour, cornmeal, seasoned salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper together in another bowl.
Dip sliced pickles in egg mixture, then in flour mixture, coating both sides and lightly pressing flour mixture into each pickle.
Spray the air fryer basket with cooking spray. Place pickles in the basket in a single layer; split into 2 batches if necessary.
Cook for 4 minutes; carefully flip pickles. Cook until desired brownness, about 4 minutes more.
Serve with sriracha mayo.
7586b2b90e3149bad192070f.title: Air Fryer Fried Pickles

76771440082dde4423f102c8.title: Air Fryer Chicken Milanese with Arugula

ingredients: 1 pound ground beef (I used ground chuck 80/20)
½ cup bell pepper  ((I used an orange bell pepper, but you can choose any color peppers))
instructions: In a skillet, over medium heat, add oil and onions. Cook the onions until they are translucent.
Add the ground beef. Using a heatproof spoon, break it into pieces and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Mix and keep cooking until the ground beef is no longer pink. Drain excess grease.
Add the diced pepper. Mix well.
Sprinkle the brown gravy mix over the meat and pour in the water. Mix well and bring to a boil.
Once the mixture is thickened and the ground beef is well coated, turn the heat off.
Preheat the air fryer to 340 degrees F.
Oil an 8-inch cake pan. (Or any pans that will fit in your air fryer.)
Pour the ground beef mixture into the prepared cake pan. Spread evenly.
Sprinkle evenly  ½ to ¾ cup of shredded cheese over the meat mixture.
Add the frozen tater tots in one layer over the cheese.
Cover and cook for 12 minutes at 340 degrees F.
Uncover and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Sprinkle 1 ½ cups of shredded cheese over the tater tots.
Air fryer for an additional 3-4 minutes or until the cheese is melted and golden to your liking.
Cool for 3-5 minutes.
Serve and Enjoy!
77a127a1a22b857520934853.title: Air Fryer Cheesesteak Tater Tot Casserole

79eb8ed54649a934fcf28f71.author: Becky
instructions: Place 2-4 frozen pretzels in air fryer basket/rack.
Brush tops of pretzels with water and then sprinkle desired amount of pretzel salt from the package of salt in the package, on pretzels.
Air fry at 350 degrees F for 3-5 minutes cook time or until cooked through.
Carefully remove the pretzels from the basket and serve warm alone or with your favorite dipping sauce, such as a beer cheese dip, honey mustard, marinara sauce, a bit of Dijon mustard, or hot sauce.
79eb8ed54649a934fcf28f71.title: Air Fryer Frozen Pretzels

7af246eb5819c40b680d5805.author: Becky
instructions: In a large bowl, stir together the flour, baking powder, salt, cream of tartar, sugar and garlic powder.
Add in the softened butter and stir with a fork until it is flaky.
Stir in the shredded cheese and the milk, until it forms into a dough.
Scoop or spoon a small amount of the dough into the basket, lined with parchment paper with holes in it, or a lightly sprayed with olive oil.
Cook at 400 degrees Fahrenheit if using a smaller basket for 5 minutes. If cooking more biscuits at a time in a larger basket, cook for 8 min.
Garlic Topping
Melt together the butter with garlic, garlic powder and parsley, and brush on the tops of the cooked biscuits. Serve warm.
7af246eb5819c40b680d5805.title: Air Fryer Copycat Red Lobster Cheddar Bay Biscuits

7c5be1b7f82055881ee4e698.author: Becky
instructions: Cut bread into small pieces, about 1/2 inch to 1 inch cubes. Add bread pieces into a large mixing bowl.
Toss bread pieces with olive oil until each piece is well coated.
Add the onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and parsley flakes. Toss with the bread cubes to coat with the seasonings.
Transfer the coated bread to the air fryer basket, spreading out as much as possible to avoid overlapping.
Air Fry at 390 degrees F for 6-7 minutes, tossing or shaking the croutons halfway through the cooking time.
7c5be1b7f82055881ee4e698.title: Air Fryer Croutons

7d9377aca620685287fb96b2.author: Becky
instructions: In a small shallow bowl or flat plate, combine the sugar and cinnamon for the topping. Stir dry ingredients together and set aside.
In a medium bowl, cream butter with brown sugar. Add in molasses, egg, baking soda, and ground ginger. Mix on medium speed until mixture becomes thick and creamy.

Slowly begin to add in flour (about a 1/4 cup at a time). Continue to mix together until a soft dough forms. Make sure all flour from sides of bowl have been fully incorporated into the dough mixture.
Use a cookie scoop or spoon shape dough into small balls (about 1-1 ½ inches in size). Roll them in cinnamon sugar mixture and set aside on a baking sheet until all dough has been used.
Line your air fryer with parchment paper and place balls in a single layer. Leave enough room between cookies to slightly spread as they cook. Air fry at 320 degrees F for 6-8 minutes.
Allow cookies to cool before removing them from your air fryer basket. If you are making a couple of batches, you can remove cookies when slightly warm and let them finish cooling on a wire rack.
7d9377aca620685287fb96b2.title: Air Fryer Gingersnap Cookies

7dcf071c65fccf19be3c903c.author: Becky
instructions: Trim the ends of the green beans before air frying, then rinse in water, to make sure they are clean.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the green beans with olive oil, salt and black pepper. Toss together until they green beans are all coated with oil and seasonings.
Transfer the green beans to the air fryer basket, and spread them in a single layer. Work in batches if necessary. (One pound green beans is usually two batches.)
Air fry at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 8-10 minutes, tossing one or two times during cooking, until they reach the desired crispness you prefer.
Remove the beans with tongs, and add additional salt, parmesan cheese, or your favorite extra seasonings, to taste.
7dcf071c65fccf19be3c903c.title: Air Fryer Green Beans

7e9fc560ffce51fb00beeb3f.author: Soup Loving Nicole
instructions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

Place green beans in a large bowl. Whisk together sesame oil, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, garlic, and red pepper flakes in a separate bowl, then pour over green beans. Toss to coat and let marinate for 5 minutes.
Place 1/2 of the green beans in the air fryer basket.
Cook in the preheated air fryer, shaking basket halfway, until crispy, about 10 to 12 minutes. Repeat with remaining green beans.
7e9fc560ffce51fb00beeb3f.title: Spicy Air Fryer Green Beans

7ef9c63dbd131f39eafede37.author: Bibi
ingredients: 1 pound frozen raw shrimp, peeled and deveined
0.5 teaspoon seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
