instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C) for 5 minutes.
While the air fryer is heating, separate frozen shrimp if necessary and knock off any ice crystals that may have developed with a spoon.
Place a single layer of frozen shrimp, about 1/2 pound, in the cooking area of the preheated air fryer and cook for 4 minutes.
Combine melted butter, seafood seasoning, and cayenne pepper in a small bowl.

When the timer sounds, brush each shrimp with seasoned butter, turn over, and brush the other side as well. Air-fry until shrimp are bright pink on the outside and the meat is opaque, 3 to 4 more minutes. Repeat with remaining shrimp.
Garnish with parsley and lemon wedges.
7ef9c63dbd131f39eafede37.title: Frozen Shrimp in the Air Fryer

instructions: Begin by peeling and cutting ripe bananas lengthwise with a sharp knife. Using a paper towel to wipe off any excess skin from banana. Place banana slices on a cutting board in a single layer.
Place butter in a medium saucepan over low heat or melt butter in microwave in a microwave safe dish.
In a small mixing bowl, combine the cinnamon and brown sugar. Take each individual banana slice and coat with butter. Then spoon sugar and cinnamon mixture over the top of each banana slice.
Next,  lightly mist basket with cooking spray or line air fryer basket with parchment paper. Place bananas slices into the air fryer basket, without overlapping.

Air fry at 380 degrees F for 6-8 minutes, gently turning the banana slices lengthwise halfway through the cooking process to keep ingredients on top of bananas. Air Fry until they are golden brown and then serve warm.
7fa75d2e3064c99b89119289.title: Air Fryer Bananas

80bb9b18dc253973d38f45ce.author: Nicole Russell
instructions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat an air fryer to 360 degrees F (180 degrees C).
Place wings in a large bowl; drizzle oil over wings and massage until chicken is evenly coated.
Arrange 1/2 of the wings in a single layer in the air fryer basket.

Cook in the preheated air fryer for 25 minutes. Use tongs to flip wings and cook until golden brown and crisp on the outside, 5 minutes more. Transfer cooked wings to a large bowl; cover to keep warm. Repeat with remaining wings.
While the second batch is cooking, combine hot pepper sauce, butter, vinegar, garlic powder, and cayenne pepper in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir and keep warm until wings are cooked.
Pour sauce over cooked wings and toss to coat.
80bb9b18dc253973d38f45ce.title: Air Fryer Chicken Wings

80bfe2ec37d0f5341bc9c360.author: Jen
instructions: Slice bacon pieces into halves. Set aside.
Slice open the tops of the dates and remove the pits if not already pitted.
In a small bowl, mix together the cream cheese and cinnamon.
Carefully spoon ½ teaspoon of the cinnamon and cream cheese mixture into each date.
Wrap each date with a piece of the bacon, and carefully secure the bacon with a toothpick if needed.
Air fry the bacon-wrapped dates at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes or until the bacon is cooked fully.
Carefully remove the stuffed dates from the air fryer and serve.
80bfe2ec37d0f5341bc9c360.title: Air Fryer Bacon Wrapped Dates

8126de91090a17cd04090169.author: Brenda Venable
ingredients: 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, or to taste
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 390 degrees F (198 degrees C), if recommended by the manufacturer. Pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels.
For sauce, combine onion powder, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Stir in  honey and Dijon mustard.
Spray one side of chicken thighs with olive oil spray, and place oiled side down in the air fryer in a single layer. Brush the tops of the chicken thighs with the sauce.
Air fry at 390 degrees F (198 degrees C) for 8 minutes.

Carefully turn chicken thighs, and brush with remaining sauce. Continue air frying until internal temperature of chicken reaches 165 degrees F (74 degrees C), when tested with an instant-read thermometer, 6 to 8 minutes more. Serve warm.
8126de91090a17cd04090169.title: Air Fryer Honey-Mustard Chicken Thighs

824ad7a2664a509f6358f5d8.author: Yoly
instructions: Remove casing from sausage and cook in a skillet over medium heat until slightly browned, 4 to 5 minutes. Add green onions, carrots, water chestnuts, and onion. Cook and stir until onions are soft and translucent, 5 to 7 minutes. Add garlic and cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Season with soy sauce, salt, and ginger. Stir until filling is well combined; remove from heat.

Lay a spring roll wrapper at an angle. Place a scant 1/4 cup filling in the center of the wrapper. Fold bottom corner over filling and tuck in the sides to form a roll. Use your finger to lightly moisten edges with water. Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling. Mist each roll with avocado oil cooking spray.
Preheat an air fryer to 390 degrees F (198 degrees C).
Place lumpia rolls in the air fryer basket, making sure they are not touching; cook in batches if necessary. Fry for 4 minutes; flip and cook until skins are crispy, about 4 minutes more.
824ad7a2664a509f6358f5d8.title: Lumpia in the Air Fryer

82db1fdb60326350a401649f.author: Jen
ingredients: 1 can biscuits (Grands, flaky are my favorite! )
instructions: Line the basket with parchment paper or lightly spray with nonstick cooking spray.
Place biscuits into the basket, in a single layer. Leave space between the biscuits.
Leave space between the biscuits. Air fry at 330 degrees F for 6-8 minutes, until golden brown.
Carefully remove from the air fryer basket and serve with sausage, gravy, chicken, bacon, or by themselves!
82db1fdb60326350a401649f.title: Air Fryer Canned Biscuits

82e65e66e82b2b4a3f817873.author: Jen
instructions: Homemade Black Bean Burger Recipe
Mash the black beans in a bowl with a fork or potato masher.
Add the onion and pepper to a food processor and pulse until mixed.
Add the vegetables to a large bowl with the black beans and stir until combined. Stir in the breadcrumbs until combined.
In a separate bowl add the egg and seasonings and whisk together. Add in the black bean mixture.
Evenly create 4 black bean burgers with the mixture.

Place the uncooked patties in the basket of the air fryer and spray the tops with olive oil. Air fry at 380 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes of cooking time, flipping the patties halfway through the cooking process.
Serve with optional mashed avocado mixture and your favorite toppings.
Frozen Black bean Burger
Place the frozen black bean patties in a single layer in the air fryer basket.
Air fry the black bean burgers at 380 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes, flipping the black bean patties halfway through the cook time.
Optional Mashed Avocado Topping
Mash the avocado in a small bowl.
Add the salt pepper, and chili powder into the mashed avocado. Mix well.
Remove the cooked black bean burgers from the air fryer and top with the avocado mixture and any additional toppings before serving.
82e65e66e82b2b4a3f817873.title: Air Fryer Black Bean Burger

838e4430cc2cec1cc2c72d44.author: Becky
ingredients: 1 cup honey barbecue sauce (or hickory and brown sugar BBQ sauce)
instructions: In a medium bowl, add the pork and beans, BBQ sauce, onion, bacon, molasses, Worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, and garlic.
Stir the ingredients until all ingredients are well combined and the beans are evenly distributed throughout the mixture.
Transfer to a 2 quart casserole dish or silicone pot that fits in your air fryer basket. (Make sure you use an air fryer safe or oven safe dish.)
Air fry at 380 degrees F for 5-8 minutes, stirring the beans after the first three minutes of air frying.
838e4430cc2cec1cc2c72d44.title: Air Fryer Baked Beans

840811970bd0db6ae3eb8213.author: Becky
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Spray the basket with cooking spray, and then place the frozen garlic knots in air fryer basket, in a single layer. Use a pastry brush and brush with the olive oil or butter mixture if using.
Air fryer for 8-10 minutes or until golden brown and crispy. You can turn them halfway through the cooking process.
Serve hot with marinara sauce, ranch dressing, or your favorite dipping sauce, if desired.
840811970bd0db6ae3eb8213.title: Air Fryer Frozen Garlic Knots

8442604e3dbcead795149be9.author: Jen
instructions: Prepare the tart pan with nonstick spray.
In a medium bowl, combine the melted butter, cinnamon, brown sugar, lemon, and vanilla extract. Set aside.
Unroll the refrigerated dough.
Press pie crust dough into the prepared tart pan.
Place the tart pan and pie crust into the basket of the air fryer. Poke holes into the crust with a fork before baking.
Air fry the pie crust at 320 degrees Fahrenheit for 4-5 minutes.
Carefully remove the tart pan.
Arrange the apples over the dough.
Brush the tops of the apples with melted butter, vanilla, cinnamon, lemon juice, and brown sugar.
Place the tart back into the basket of the air fryer.
Air fry at 320 degrees Fahrenheit for 16-20 minutes.
Allow the tart to cool slightly before slicing and serving.
8442604e3dbcead795149be9.title: Air Fryer Apple Tart

8448c41b3698ba845e860c5f.author: Becky
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the melted butter, brown sugar, cinnamon and vanilla, set aside.

Place apples on a cutting board. Using a small sharp knife, carefully cut the top of each apple off and then use melon baller to scoop out the center of each apple to remove the core and seeds. Leaving a bit of room at the bottom of each apple, and do not cut all the way through.

Make two round cuts in apple center with a paring knife. Then turn the apple upside down. Cut downward starting about a 1/4 inch from the base of the apple to create 6-8 slices of apple. Flip over and it will look like a flower blooming.
Fill the center of the apple with caramel bites. Use a spoon or pastry brush to coat the outside of apples and inside of each separate petal with the mixture of sugar and butter.

Spray air fryer basket with nonstick cooking spray and place apples inside at 350 degrees F for 10-12 minutes. Keep a close watch on apples during cooking time so they turn out softened to your preference. Best when served warm or immediately if possible.
8448c41b3698ba845e860c5f.title: Air Fryer Bloomin' Apple

85220704daaf3fc08930f0ee.author: Becky
instructions: Prepare the pan by lining the bottom with a circle of parchment paper, and then lightly butter the insides of the pan walls so the cheesecake will easily be removed after cooking.
Crush the Oreo Cookies in the food processor, until they are fine crumbs. (Or you can place them in a large bag and crush them with a rolling pin.
Pour the crushed cookies into a large bowl, and stir in the melted butter to mix with the crumbs.
Pour the mixture into the prepared springform pan, pressing the crust firmly to the bottom of the pan. Set the pan aside.
In a microwave safe bowl, melt the chocolate chips, stirring after one minute to make sure the chips have completely melted and are smooth. Set the bowl aside as you prepare the filling.
In a large bowl, or using a stand mixer, beat the cream cheese until it is smooth.

Add in the powdered sugar, corn starch, eggs, and vanilla. Quickly stir in the melted chocolate, until the filling is well combined and smooth. Pour the filling over the crust and spread it evenly with a spatula or spoon.
Place the springform pan in the basket of the air fryer. Cook at 300 degrees  Fahrenheit for 18 minutes.
Remove from the basket and allow the cheesecake to chill to set, for about 6-8 hours, or chill in the freezer for about an hour.
85220704daaf3fc08930f0ee.title: Air Fryer Chocolate Cheesecake

8607c4d73b20ab9d1aa7317b.author: bdweld
ingredients: 4 slices slightly stale thick bread, such as Texas toast
instructions: Cut each slice of bread into thirds to make sticks. Cut a piece of parchment paper to fit the bottom of the air fryer basket.
Preheat air fryer to 360 degrees F (180 degrees C).

Stir together eggs, milk, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a bowl until well combined. Dip each piece of bread into egg mixture, making sure each piece is well submerged. Shake each bread stick to remove excess liquid and place in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Cook in batches, if necessary, to avoid overcrowding the fryer.
Cook for 5 minutes, turn bread pieces, and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
8607c4d73b20ab9d1aa7317b.title: Easy Air Fryer French Toast Sticks

867d5a0bee0df11021c7e781.author: Becky
ingredients: 2  boneless skinless chicken breast (6 ounces each)
instructions: To make Air Fryer Chicken Cordon Bleu, begin by using a sharp knife to butterfly each chicken breast in half without cutting all the way through.

Lay each chicken breast between two pieces of plastic wrap, or in an unsealed gallon Ziploc freezer bag. Use a meat mallet and pound chicken until they are evenly flattened, about ¼ inch in thickness.

Lay each piece flat on the cutting board, then place one or two slices swiss cheese and then top with a slice of ham, in the middle of the chicken and fold chicken ends over and seal with toothpicks, to keep ends of chicken closed while cooking.
Place the whisked egg in a shallow dish or bowl. In a separate medium bowl or baking dish, that is shallow, combine the salt, pepper and breadcrumbs.
Roll the chicken in the egg mixture, and then dredge through the breadcrumb mixture, fully covering the outside of each piece of chicken.
Place chicken breasts in a single layer, without overlapping into a lightly sprayed air fryer basket.
Air fry at 380 degrees F for 13-18 minutes until the chicken is cooked and golden brown.
867d5a0bee0df11021c7e781.title: Air Fryer Chicken Cordon Bleu

879a2bdbcde6b65dd5c654e0.author: Jen
instructions: Cut the crust off of the slices of bread and then take a glass or rolling pin to flatten the bread.
Use a butter knife and spread a thin layer of butter over both sides of the bread.
Add the cheese slices to the bread and then roll them.
Place the grilled cheese roll ups into the prepared air fryer basket. Cook on 360 degrees Fahrenheit for 5-6 minutes, flipping the roll-ups halfway through.
Serve immediately.
879a2bdbcde6b65dd5c654e0.title: Air Fryer Grilled Cheese Roll Ups

87e99caadb5ec194f974d832.author: Becky
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 380 degrees F.

While the air fryer is preheating, remove the bread from its packaging. Cut the loaves into slices if the bread is not already sliced. (If that's how you want to serve it. You can also keep it in loaf shape, just separate the top and the bottom.)
Place the garlic bread slices in the preheated air fryer basket, in a single layer, without stacking or overlapping. Be sure to place the slices with the buttered and seasoned side facing up first.
Air fry garlic bread at 380 degrees F for 4-6 minutes, until it is golden brown and crispy to your preference.
87e99caadb5ec194f974d832.title: Air Fryer Frozen Garlic Bread

8821a24972f657236f1f2193.title: How to Reheat Pizza in an Air Fryer

88509d01d20a77aeb67ad820.author: Becky
instructions: Rinse broccolini, then cut the ends off broccolini stems (about an inch) and pat dry with a paper towel.
In a shallow dish toss the broccolini with olive oil. Then add garlic and seasonings.
Toss broccolini until it is fully coated. Place broccolini in the air fryer basket and cook at 380 degrees F for 5-7 minutes until it reaches your desired crispiness.
Serve this quick side dish while hot.
88509d01d20a77aeb67ad820.title: Air Fryer Broccolini

instructions: In a small bowl, add the eggs and milk and whisk together. Pour the egg mixture onto a rimmed shallow bowl or plate for easier dipping.
Take a slice of bread and dip it into the egg mixture, coating both sides.
Add the cinnamon sugar to each piece of bread, and then place the bread slices in a single layer in the prepared air fryer basket.

Air fry the French toast for 8-10 minutes at 390 degrees Fahrenheit, carefully flipping the toast after 5 minutes. Depending on the size of the basket or the size of the air fryer, you may have to cook these in two batches. Check after 8 minutes as each air fryer is different and can cook differently. You may need to add more time or remove the french toast earlier.
Once golden brown and fully cooked, remove the toast from the air fryer, add an extra dash of the cinnamon-sugar mixture, and top with fresh berries, melted butter, confectioners' sugar, and syrup.
88d764a9424912ba8922c46a.title: Air Fryer French Toast

8983eee2d4bfc764bf1a1ffd.author: Becky
instructions: Place the bacon slices in the basket of the air fryer in a single layer. (It's ok if the bacon overlaps a little) Close the basket door and air fry at 380 degrees Fahrenheit for 8-10 minutes. Check the bacon after 8 minutes for doneness. Don’t let it get too crispy or it will break when rolling.
While bacon is cooking, open cinnamon roll package, and separate dough. Reserve icing packet for later. If using homemade cinnamon roll dough, cut into 6 x 1-inch strips to use for this recipe.

When bacon is done, unroll each strip of dough. Place one to two strips of bacon on each piece of dough, and then re-roll the cinnamon roll into its original shape. Repeat with remaining cinnamon rolls.

Lightly spray the air fryer basket with nonstick cooking spray, or line with air fryer parchment paper. Place the cinnamon roll dough in the Air Fryer basket, leaving a little space in between each cinnamon roll.

Air fry at 360 degrees F for 6- 8 minutes to allow the cinnamon rolls to fully cook, until they are a golden brown color. If you want the tops to be a little crispier, consider adding an additional minute to the cook time.
Remove the cinnamon rolls from the Air Fryer and top the rolls with icing while they are still warm. Serve immediately. Top with powdered sugar or chocolate chips while warm, if using.
8983eee2d4bfc764bf1a1ffd.title: Air Fryer Bacon Cinnamon Rolls

89d05bebda317f4512e89694.author: Laura Rege
89d05bebda317f4512e89694.title: Air Fryer Apple Pie Baked Apples

89e3f20dda868fc8bd5f3953.author: Laura Rege
89e3f20dda868fc8bd5f3953.title: Air Fryer Acorn Squash with Black Beans, Corn, and Cheese

8a07a8ad7b6427581c2e48cc.author: Becky
instructions: Lightly rinse and pat fish dry with a paper towel. Set aside.
Combine the paprika, chili powder, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine.
Brush each piece of fish with olive oil to coat fish on both sides and then sprinkle to coat with seasoning mixture.
Without overlapping, place fish fillets in the Air Fryer basket in a single layer. Air fry at 350ºF for 6-8 minutes until golden brown.
8a07a8ad7b6427581c2e48cc.title: Air Fryer Cod

8be31259d70ec7484f613434.author: Becky
ingredients: 1  Box of Spice Cake Mix (Or you favorite flavor)
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 350 degrees F.

In a large mixing bowl, stir together the cake mix and the pumpkin puree until combined. The mixture will be a little thick. (You can use a hand mixer, or stand electric mixer, but it's pretty easy to stir the ingredients together with a fork or whisk in the large bowl)
Lightly spray the inside of each silicone muffin liner with non stick spray.
Scoop out about 1/3 cup of pumpkin muffin batter into each liner, filling about 3/4 of the way full. (I used a medium portion scoop, and was able to make 18 muffins)
Air fry at 350 degrees F, for 15-18 minutes, until they are golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center of one comes out clean.
Transfer the muffins to a wire rack on the counter, to cool. Serve warm or at room temperature.
8be31259d70ec7484f613434.title: Air Fryer 2 Ingredient Pumpkin Muffins

8c8f89bc8cd4e6b65e41f272.author: Laura Rege
8c8f89bc8cd4e6b65e41f272.title: Air Fryer Korean-Inspired Pork Tenderloin Lettuce Wraps

8ce542aa12bf8166dd8bd1d4.author: lutzflcat
ingredients: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
0.5 (15.25 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
0.33 cup sour cream, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat the air fryer at 360 degrees F (182 degrees C) for about 5 minutes. Line the air fryer basket with foil or a parchment liner, and spray with cooking spray.

Heat a small skillet over medium heat and cook ground beef until browned and crumbly, about 3 minutes; drain grease. Stir in water, taco seasoning, cayenne, salt, and pepper. Remove skillet from heat.

Set tortilla chips in the basket, spreading them out and overlapping slightly so the melted cheese won't drip through the open gaps. Evenly sprinkle Cheddar cheese over the chips. Only add a couple of layers of chips with cheese in between in the fryer basket, or just add a single layer and cook in batches.
Evenly distribute ground beef and black beans over the cheese, sprinkle green onions on top, and add spoonfuls of salsa.

Transfer the basket into the air fryer and cook until cheese is melted and starting to slightly brown on the edges, 4 to 6 minutes. The nachos will cook evenly and quickly but watch closely so they don't burn.
Remove nachos to a serving plate, garnish with sour cream, and serve immediately. Put extra toppings in small bowls and let everybody customize their nachos.
8ce542aa12bf8166dd8bd1d4.title: Quick and Easy Air Fryer Nachos

8e1cfc98ebd441485b5e597d.author: Becky
ingredients: 1 can cranberry sauce ((you will only use about half))
instructions: Cube the cheese into pieces. Gently press a brie piece into the cup with a spoon or using your fingers.  Cut a bite size piece for each cup, which is about 1-inch cubes.
Once the cups have been lined with cheese, top the brie with cranberry sauce. I used about a teaspoon of cranberry sauce on each piece.
Place the cups in the air fryer basket or on a small baking sheet. Air Fry at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 3-5 minutes, until golden brown. If they aren't warm, add an additional 1-2 minutes.
8e1cfc98ebd441485b5e597d.title: Air Fryer Cranberry Brie Bites

8e3422c1a663cddcb685945d.title: Air Fryer Chicken Milanese with Mediterranean Salad

8f291f82e5842e630135c5f9.author: bdweld
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C) according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Combine oil, lemon juice, lemon pepper, paprika, and garlic powder in a bowl. Add shrimp and toss to coat.
Cook shrimp in the preheated air fryer until they are bright pink on the outside and the meat is opaque, about 6 to 8 minutes. Serve with lemon slices.
8f291f82e5842e630135c5f9.title: Air Fryer Lemon Pepper Shrimp

90b5f4f2ec5a6d4037d3398e.author: Jen
ingredients: Salsa, guacamole, and queso for serving  (for garnish)
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the shredded chicken, cream cheese, and taco seasoning. Mix well.
Fold in the Mexican cheese until just blended.
Warm the tortillas in the microwave for about 30 seconds, or heat them on a skillet over low to medium heat on the stovetop.
Scoop 2 Tablespoons of the chicken and cheese mixture onto a corn tortilla. Wrap the tortilla, and repeat until all taquitos have been made.
Add the taquitos into the air fryer basket in a single layer. Spray the tops of the taquitos with the avocado oil spray.
Air fry the chicken taquitos at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 5 minutes, flip and spray with oil, and air fry for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until desired crispiness has been reached.
Serve with salsa, guacamole, sour cream, and queso.
90b5f4f2ec5a6d4037d3398e.title: Air Fryer Chicken Taquitos

916ac89ba9f629e2bcc5e885.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat the Air Fryer to 380 degrees Fahrenheit/193 degrees Celcius.
If needed, prepare the air fryer basket with olive oil, aluminum foil, parchment paper, or a non stick cooking spray.
Place the frozen fish fillets into the air fryer basket in a single layer directly from the freezer. No thawing is needed.
Air Fry the fish fillets for 10 minutes.
Carefully flip the fish fillets and cook for an additional 2-4 minutes, depending on crispness, and until they are golden brown.
916ac89ba9f629e2bcc5e885.title: Air Fryer Frozen Fish Fillets

945eb66dc896cf7c413acff7.author: Laura Rege
945eb66dc896cf7c413acff7.title: Air Fryer Fish Tacos with Avocado Salsa

949e8401ea194ed85b11c3e4.author: Jen
instructions: Take the graham crackers and add them to a food processor. Continue to blend and pulse until they are finely crushed. Place into a small mixing bowl.
Add the melted butter to the graham crackers and mix until fully combined. Set aside.
Add butter to the bottom and sides of the 7" Springform pan. Place a piece of parchment paper on the bottom of the pan.
Press the graham cracker mixture into the bottom of the pan. Use a spoon to press the graham cracker crust down firmly.

In a medium mixing bowl, use a hand mixer or a stand mixer on medium speed to blend the room temperature cream cheese until creamy and smooth. Add the eggs, condensed milk, and vanilla to the cream cheese and blend on medium speed until the mixture is completely smooth. About 2 minutes.
Pour the cream cheese mixture over the graham cracker crust. It will fill almost completely up to the rim of the 7" cheesecake pan.
Carefully place the springform pan into the basket of the Air Fryer. (You do not preheat the Air Fryer for this recipe).

Bake in the Air Fryer at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 20-22 minutes, or until the center is no longer jiggling. (It will still wiggle, but won't be a wet jiggle.) If needed, continue to add 2 minutes increments at 300 degrees Fahrenheit until the center is perfect.

When ready, crack the air fryer basket to release the heat and let the cheesecake sit for a few moments. Then carefully remove the air fryer basket and let it cool a bit longer on the counter. Once cooled, chill it in the refrigerator for 6-8 hours, or overnight.
Once chilled, carefully remove the circular sides of the springform pan and place the cheesecake on a serving platter. Top with the cherry pie filling just before slicing and serving.
949e8401ea194ed85b11c3e4.title: Air Fryer Cheesecake

94be9e5373a59ca042174a8b.author: Bren
94be9e5373a59ca042174a8b.title: Air Fryer Garlic and Parsley Baby Potatoes

9534ee98a73db61a09724219.author: SUSUMILLER
ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Gather the ingredients.
Stir together flour and pepper in a shallow dish. Lightly beat eggs in a second shallow dish. Stir together coconut and panko in a third shallow dish.

Working one at a time, dredge shrimp in flour mixture; shake off excess. Dip floured shrimp in egg; allow any excess to drip off. Finally, dredge in coconut mixture, pressing to adhere. Place shrimp on a plate. Coat shrimp well with cooking spray.

Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Place 1/2 of the shrimp in the air fryer and cook about 3 minutes. Turn shrimp over and continue cooking until golden, about 3 minutes more. Season with 1/4 teaspoon salt. Repeat with remaining shrimp.
Meanwhile, whisk together honey, lime juice, and serrano chile in a small bowl.
Sprinkle fried shrimp with cilantro and serve with honey-lime dip.
9534ee98a73db61a09724219.title: Air Fryer Coconut Shrimp

970a610cfa74c54bdf688511.author: Becky
ingredients: 1 tablespoon honey (or flavored liqueur such as Chambord or Bailey's Irish Creme)
instructions: Prepare the cheese by removing the brie rind on top of the cheese wheel only. Leave the rind around the sides and bottom of the cheese.
Place cheese in a small ramekin or oven safe dish. Place brie in center or your basket. Air fry at 350 degrees F for 5-7 minutes until the cheese is soft and warm.
While cheese is in air fryer, in a small, microwave safe bowl, combine the cranberries, almonds, and honey or liquor. Stir together and then microwave for 30-45 seconds, until warm.
Pour ingredients over the top of the brie and serve while hot.
970a610cfa74c54bdf688511.title: Air Fryer Brie

9740d7f20cd68a94f1b2ece8.author: Paul Tannos
ingredients: 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or more to taste
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C) according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Combine paprika, chili powder, cumin, onion powder, garlic powder, black pepper, salt, and cayenne in a small bowl.
Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels. Place wings in a large bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and toss to coat. Sprinkle spice mixture over wings and toss until evenly coated.

Arrange wings in a single layer in the air fryer basket without overlapping, working in batches if needed. Air fry, turning halfway through, until wings are browned and an instant-read thermometer inserted near the bone reads 165 degrees F (74 degrees C), about 12 minutes.
For crispier wings, increase air fryer temperature to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C) and cook for 2 to 3 minutes more.
9740d7f20cd68a94f1b2ece8.title: Spicy Air Fryer Wings

974d87169d4a917aa22d6e28.author: Brenda Venable
ingredients: 3 New York strip steaks, about 1 1/4-inch thick
1/2 teaspoon of your favorite seasoned salt, or to taste
1/2 teaspoon Montreal Steak Seasoning, or other seasoning of choice
1 Teaspoon Worcestershire sauce, optional, to taste
instructions: About 30 minutes before cooking, remove the steaks from the refrigerator and allow them to come to room temperature. Pat steaks dry with paper towels, and sprinkle seasoning salt and Montreal Steak Seasoning on both sides.
Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C), according to manufacturer’s instructions.
When the air fryer is fully preheated, spray both sides of steaks with olive oil cooking spray.
Place steaks in the air fryer and cook about 10 minutes for medium rare, turning halfway through.

Check the temperature of the meat before removing from the air fryer. For medium-rare, an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read 130 degrees F (54 degrees C). Tent with foil, about 10 minutes. Serve warm.
974d87169d4a917aa22d6e28.title: Air Fryer New York Strip Steak

988ce31125760ebae6beb974.author: Becky
instructions: In a medium bowl, toss edamame in olive oil, garlic powder, and salt until well coated.
Transfer edamame to the air fryer basket, without stacking or overlapping.
Air fry at 400 degrees F for 8-10 minutes, shaking 2 or 3 times during the cooking process so they get an even cook.
Remove the basket from the air fryer and allow them to slightly cool prior to eating. Discard edamame pods and enjoy the seeds.
988ce31125760ebae6beb974.title: Air Fryer Edamame

9975c0ceb932e937ebda01ee.author: Becky
ingredients: 2.5 pounds pork chops (bone in or boneless, about 3-4 chops)
instructions: Preheat Air Fryer to 390F for 5 minutes.
In a shallow medium bowl whisk together the egg and water.
In a shallow, separate bowl, to make the dry mixture, combine the flour, cheese, and seasonings.
Pat pork chops dry with a paper towel. Then, dredge the pork chop in the egg mixture, coating both sides.
Once coated with egg, dredge each piece of meat through the second bowl with flour and seasoning mix, coating both sides.

Spray the inside of the air fryer basket with non-stick cooking spray and place chops in basket in a single layer. (Depending on the size of your air fryer basket and pork chops you may need to cook them individually)
Air fry at 390F for 13-15 minutes flipping it halfway through air frying cooking process. If using thinner chops, adjust cook time by 1-2 minutes.
Remove from the basket when meat thermometer reads an internal temperature of at least 145F.
Let pork chops rest about 5 minutes before cutting. Season pork chops with your favorite seasonings.
9975c0ceb932e937ebda01ee.title: Air Fryer Gluten Free Pork Chops

9adac467b62a4a402a6b160f.author: Jen
instructions: Prepare the air fryer basket with a nonstick cooking spray if needed.
Butter both sides of each piece of bread. Place the bread in a single layer in the basket of the air fryer.
Take the bacon and give it a little twist in the middle, and create a little "nest" for the egg.
Crack open the egg and carefully place it into the center of the bacon nest.
Air fry the sandwich at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 7-8 minutes.
Carefully remove the breakfast sandwich from the air fryer, sprinkle with salt and pepper, and serve immediately.
9adac467b62a4a402a6b160f.title: Air Fryer Breakfast Sandwich

9b3690d75f6798731ce1a21f.author: Becky
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 380 degrees F for 3-5 minutes.
Place 2-4 frozen turkey patties in the air fryer.
Air fry for 8-10 minutes, flip patties halfway through cooking. Air fry until the internal temperature reaches 165 degrees F using a digital thermometer.
If adding a slice of cheese to patties, let them sit for 1-2 minutes until the cheese has melted on top of the burger.
9b3690d75f6798731ce1a21f.title: Air Fryer Frozen Turkey Burger

9efa8af090b7351328f42b88.author: Ali Ramee, Afton Cyrus
9efa8af090b7351328f42b88.title: The Secret to No-Mess “Fried” Chicken Is in the Snack Aisle

9fb6b2fc93754884c89c60ec.author: Becky
instructions: Lightly oil or use air fryer parchment paper liners to prepare the air fryer basket. Set aside.
Roll out the pastry sheet so that it is a true rectangle. Evenly brush the BBQ sauce on top of the sheet.
Season the sauce with the red pepper flakes and garlic powder, and then sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the sauce,
Drain the can of chicken and lightly shred any large chunks. Spread the chicken over the cheese.
Top the pizza with chopped onion and crumbled bacon, then, tightly roll the the dough lengthwise until it is a long roll.
Slice the roll into eight pieces and place in the air fryer basket, cut side down.
Air fry at 370 degrees F for about 5-6  minutes, until the crust is golden.
9fb6b2fc93754884c89c60ec.title: Air Fryer BBQ Chicken Pizza Rolls

9fc59f77232f12263270e70a.author: Soup Loving Nicole
instructions: Whisk olive oil, 2 teaspoons lemon-pepper seasoning, paprika, and garlic powder together in a bowl. Add wings and toss to coat.
Sprinkle remaining 1 teaspoon lemon-pepper seasoning over the wings and let sit for 5 minutes while you preheat the air fryer to 360 degrees F (180 degrees C).
Stand wings up along the sides of the air fryer basket making sure to not overcrowd.
Cook wings in the air fryer until chicken is no longer pink at the bone and the juices run clear, for 25 minutes. After the timer goes off, let wings sit inside the closed basket for 5 minutes.
9fc59f77232f12263270e70a.title: Air Fryer Lemon Pepper Wings

a0e27810153ea341aeeed136.author: Soup Loving Nicole
a0e27810153ea341aeeed136.title: Air Fryer Scrambled Eggs On The Go

a15bba3540e34842c335e904.author: Becky
instructions: Take a sheet of aluminum foil and shape it around the bottom or edges of each banana without covering the top.
Cut a slit in the top of the banana, pulling the peel slightly open. Fill each banana with chocolate chips, and then top with marshmallows and crushed graham crackers.
Place in the air fryer basket and air fry at 350 degrees F for 4-6 minutes.
a15bba3540e34842c335e904.title: Air Fryer Banana Boats

a1863aea69e86ea42e3a125a.author: Soup Loving Nicole
instructions: Preheat the oven to 380 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Spread out frozen meatballs in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Spray tops with cooking spray.
Cook in the air fryer for 4 minutes. Shake, and cook for an additional 4 minutes.
a1863aea69e86ea42e3a125a.title: How to Cook Frozen Meatballs in the Air Fryer

a31d00e315c717670ed469fb.author: Jen
instructions: Rinse the asparagus in cold water then pat the fresh asparagus spears dry with a paper towel.
Trim the ends of the asparagus (approximately 2 inches) with a sharp kitchen knife and set aside.
Whisk the eggs together in a shallow bowl.
In a separate bowl, combine the panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, smoked paprika and ground black pepper.
Then pour the breadcrumb mixture into a second shallow dish.
Dip asparagus spears in the egg mixture, then dip each spear into the breadcrumb coating. Make sure you have a full uniform coating on each spear.
Spray each asparagus with cooking spray (olive oil).
Place the breaded spears in a single layer into the air fryer basket.
Air fry asparagus fries at 400 degrees F for 7-8 minutes, use a pair of tongs and flip the asparagus halfway through the cooking process.
Carefully remove them from the air fryer basket and place them on a baking sheet with parchment paper to fully cool if making more than one batch.
Serve while hot.
a31d00e315c717670ed469fb.title: Air Fryer Asparagus Fries

a3815c737abe5e746c378c2e.author: Becky
instructions: Prepare the pan by lining the bottom with a circle of parchment paper, and then lightly butter the insides of the pan walls so the cheesecake will easily be removed after cooking.
Crush the graham crackers in the food processor, until they are fine crumbs.
Pour them into a large bowl, and stir in the melted butter to mix with the crumbs.
Pour the mixture into the prepared springform pan, pressing the crust firmly to the bottom of the pan. Set the pan aside while making the filling.
In a large bowl, or using a stand mixer, beat the cream cheese until it is smooth.
Add in the eggs, sweetened condensed milk, and vanilla. Continue beating on medium speed until it is smooth and creamy.
Pour the filling over the crust and spread it evenly with a spatula or spoon.
Place the springform pan in the basket of the air fryer. Cook at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 15 minutes.
Remove from the basket and allow the cheesecake to chill to set, for about 6-8 hours, or overnight.
a3815c737abe5e746c378c2e.title: Air Fryer Cheesecake

a38d8e00df434c6677b6970b.author: Nicole McLaughlin
ingredients: 2 pounds pork tenderloin, cut in 1 1/2 inch pieces
1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper, or to taste
24 1 inch chunk pieces of fresh pineapple plus 2 tablespoons pineapple juice
1 small red onion, cut in 1 inch pieces
instructions: Add pork pieces with 2/3 cup teriyaki sauce, salt, crushed red pepper and pineapple juice to a large zip lock bag. Seal the bag and toss to incorporate the ingredients thoroughly and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours.
Remove pork from the bag and discard marinade. Thread pork evenly onto skewers along with pineapple chunks and red onion.
Preheat the air fryer to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Lightly coat the air fryer basket with cooking spray and cook skewers 15 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Stir remaining teriyaki sauce with water in a small bowl and microwave until warm. Sprinkle skewers with green onions and serve with sauce.
a38d8e00df434c6677b6970b.title: Air Fryer Teriyaki Pork Skewers

a3ddd13aa7853d6d198e1cf7.author: Becky
instructions: Spread butter or mayo on one side of each slice of bread. Place a slice of cheese between the unbuttered sides so the buttered sides are on the outside. To keep the bread from lifting while cooking, you can secure it with toothpicks. Just remember to remove them before serving.

Preheat the air fryer for 3-5 minutes. Then place the sandwich in the air fryer basket. Cook at 370 degrees F (188 degrees C) for 4–5 minutes, then carefully flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
Let it cool for a minute or two, then slice and serve.
a3ddd13aa7853d6d198e1cf7.title: Air Fryer Grilled Cheese Sandwich

a518d745474a15d20daa087d.author: Coco Morante
a518d745474a15d20daa087d.title: The 2-Ingredient Recipe That Made My Kids Love Cauliflower

a5313722751d2b15aaebbc07.author: Jen
instructions: Place the buns into the air fryer basket in a single layer.
Open the buns and scoop a small layer of chili into the bun.
Top the chili with a hot dog.
Top the hot dog with more chili, then top it off with shredded cheddar cheese.
Air fry at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 8 minutes.
Remove and serve while hot.
a5313722751d2b15aaebbc07.title: Air Fryer Chili Cheese Dogs

a59bbcc7ab7ac5cc10acd84b.author: Jen
instructions: To make your air fryer fried rice, put your cold rice into an large bowl.
Mix in the frozen vegetables to the bowl of rice.
Add the scrambled eggs into the rice and vegetables.
Add the sesame oil and oyster sauce. Mix well until fully combined.
Transfer the rice mixture to an oven safe container like a ramekin.

Place that container into your air fryer. Cook the air fried rice at 360 degrees F for 15 minutes stirring every 5 minutes. Add in the green onion tops during the last minutes of cooking time, stirring them in until well combined.
Serve immediately.
a59bbcc7ab7ac5cc10acd84b.title: Air Fryer Fried Rice

a5fd00cbb0afcd995cd2ef90.author: Becky
instructions: Rinse and dry apples with paper towels. Peel skin and then dice apples into small bites. Combine apples and lemon juice in a medium bowl and set aside.
In a separate bowl, combine the melted butter, sugar, oats, flour, and cinnamon. Stir ingredients together until it becomes a crumble. Set bowl aside.
Lightly spray non-stick cooking spray on the insides of your small ramekins. Spoon apple mixture equally into the individual ramekins.
Air fry at 300 degrees F for 8-10 minutes, until apples are cooked through and tender. You can check using a fork to make sure apples are softened.
Spoon oat topping mixture over the apples, and then return basket to the air fryer. Air fry at 300 degrees F for an additional 3-5 minutes, until oatmeal topping is golden brown and slightly crispy.
a5fd00cbb0afcd995cd2ef90.title: Air Fryer Apple Crisp

a6aaaa451e33b6729db519d3.author: Soup Loving Nicole
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Place pepperoni in the air fryer basket, slightly overlapping, if needed.
Cook for 5 minutes. Using tongs, transfer slices to a paper towel-lined plate; let sit 5 minutes to finish crisping. Eat immediately or refrigerate, stored in an air-tight container.
a6aaaa451e33b6729db519d3.title: Air Fryer Pepperoni Chips

a6c5924d433d14cfdf8676bc.author: Becky
instructions: Peel and remove avocado pits, then peel and remove skins.
Slice avocados into equal size wedges.
Wrap each wedge with a slice of bacon, covering the entire wedge.
Place wedges with the end piece of the bacon face down in the air fryer basket.
Air fry at 380 degrees F for 10-12 minutes until bacon is crispy and cooked to your desired doneness.
a6c5924d433d14cfdf8676bc.title: Air Fryer Bacon Wrapped Avocado

instructions: Put the cinnamon and sugar into a bowl. Set aside.
Open the can of biscuits and peel each biscuit into two layers. Using a rolling pin roll each layer into a 4-inch circle, you will end up with 16 circles.
Spoon about a tablespoon of the cherry pie filling into the center of each circle.
Pull the sides together and pinch to seal, then roll them into balls.
Prepare your basket or spray your air fryer basket with a non-stick cooking spray.
Place the balls into the air fryer basket about 2 inches apart, you may need to make a couple of batches.
Spray the top of the balls with your cooking spray.
Air fry at 350 degrees for 8-9 minutes, until they are golden brown.
Carefully remove the Air Fryer Cherry Pie Bombs from the air fryer, roll in the cinnamon and sugar mixture and serve.
a7cc9ff7ed763e69fd4dfc9d.title: Air Fryer Cherry Pie Bombs

a8409030a39e06675f19ad67.author: Allrecipes Member
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 390 degrees F (195 degrees C).
Sift flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt into a bowl. Cut butter into flour mixture, using a pastry cutter. Add buttermilk until just combined.
Flour a work surface and, using your hands, bring dough together and fold 5 to 6 times, ending with a 1-inch thick rectangle.
Cut biscuits with a 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter. Bring leftover dough together to be able to cut more biscuits.
Place biscuits into the air fryer basket and air-fry until golden brown, 8 to 10 minutes.
a8409030a39e06675f19ad67.title: Air Fryer Buttermilk Biscuits

a85dd960ebab82304a23bc1a.author: Soup Loving Nicole
a85dd960ebab82304a23bc1a.title: Air Fryer Salt and Vinegar Pumpkin Seeds

a8ab4f57487885bf62253445.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat your Air Fryer to 400°F (200°C). If your air fryer basket tends to stick, spray it lightly with nonstick cooking spray.
Arrange the frozen curly fries in a single layer at the bottom of the air fryer basket. Avoid overcrowding to ensure even cooking and crispiness.
Cook the curly fries at 400°F (200°C) for 10 minutes. Toss the fries halfway through the cooking time to promote even browning and crispiness.
Once the fries are golden brown and crispy, remove them from the air fryer and serve immediately with your favorite dipping sauces.
a8ab4f57487885bf62253445.title: Air Fryer Frozen Curly Fries

a92af27a5aa6e9cc0c946c4c.author: Jen
instructions: Combine the flour, baking powder, and cocoa powder into a mixing bowl and set aside.
Add the cream cheese, butter, and sugar to a medium sized mixing bowl. Use a hand mixer to blend the ingredients until they are completely combined and creamy, about 2 minutes.
Combine the eggs, and vanilla and to the butter and sugar mixture and blend until mixed well.
Add the flour mixture to the butter and sugar mixture and slowly combine. Mix well.
Pour the batter into the prepared bundt cake pan.
Place the bundt cake pan into the air fryer basket.
Cook at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 15-18 minutes. Add additional increments of 1 minute if needed.
Remove the basket from the air fryer and allow it to cool for a few minutes.
Carefully remove the bundt cake from the air fryer and allow to cool completely.
Carefully flip the bundt cake over onto a serving dish. Cover with a chocolate glaze or frosting, then slice and serve.
a92af27a5aa6e9cc0c946c4c.title: Air Fryer Chocolate Bundt Cake

aa54e45f0008bf3609d47f38.author: Bibi
ingredients: 1 pound sweet potatoes, peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C) as directed by air fryer manufacturer.

Place sweet potato chunks in a mixing bowl. Drizzle melted butter over sweet potatoes and stir to coat. Add salt, cayenne pepper, ginger, and sugar or any combination of these spices; stir to combine. Place sweet potatoes in the air fryer in a single layer.
Air-fry for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring or shaking sweet potatoes halfway through the air frying time. Serve warm.
aa54e45f0008bf3609d47f38.title: Air Fryer Roasted Sweet Potatoes

aad14a5f7933a9fee7c165a4.author: Jen
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast (cut into bite sized pieces)
1 medium red bell pepper (cut into pieces)
1 medium green bell pepper (cut into pieces)
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 3 minutes.
Cut the chicken breast into bite sized pieces.
Chop the vegetables and add them into a bowl with the chicken.
Add the seasonings and pour the olive oil over the chicken and vegetables. Mix well.
Add the vegetables to the basket of the air fryer.
Air fry at 400 degrees Fahrenheit (200C) for 15 minutes, tossing the chicken and vegetables halfway through the cooking time.
Use a spatula to serve.
aad14a5f7933a9fee7c165a4.title: Air Fryer Chicken and Vegetables

ac8baf86094bd6358c238c98.author: Jessica Beacom
ac8baf86094bd6358c238c98.title: Air Fryer Artichokes with Feta Yogurt Dip

acb71b98f8a9b34dd44e999d.author: Makinze Gore
acb71b98f8a9b34dd44e999d.title: Air Fryer Garlic Herb Turkey Breast

acc3191a91311e2586e87cea.author: Becky
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 380 degrees F for 3-5 minutes.

While the air fryer is preheating, carefully use paper towels to pat the chicken dry, and then discard the paper towel. In a small bowl, mix the paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper together.
Lightly brush each piece of chicken with olive oil, on both sides. Then sprinkle seasoning over both sides of each piece and place the chicken in a single layer in the preheated air fryer.
Air fry chicken breasts at 380 degrees Fahrenheit for 8-10 minutes on each side. Cook times may vary, depending on the thickness.
Chicken will be golden on the outside. To safely confirm doneness, use a meat thermometer in the thicken part of the chicken breast. Chicken should have internal temperature of 165 degrees F.
acc3191a91311e2586e87cea.title: Air Fryer Chicken Breast

adbef249bd34b12db7c30c46.author: Becky
instructions: To make these fried Cadbury eggs, begin by unwrapping each egg from their foil wrapper.
Open the crescent rolls and separate dough into the pre-cut triangles. Wrap one egg in each piece of pastry, making sure to completely cover the egg. Pinch the dough to cover any exposed chocolate.
To prepare the air fryer basket, lightly spray or line with parchment paper, to prevent sticking. Place each wrapped egg in the air fryer basket. If making multiple eggs, keep them in a single layer.
Air Fry at 350° Fahrenheit for 6 minutes, until they are golden brown.
Serve warm, or you can allow the eggs to cool so the liquid crème filling can become less gooey.
adbef249bd34b12db7c30c46.title: Air Fried Cadbury Eggs

ae0a88894a9159ace8d6305d.author: Becky
instructions: Open the canned pineapple chunks and drain juice in colander. Remove 24 chunks for this dish. Cover and store remaining pineapple for later use.
Gently pat the chunks dry with paper towels to remove excess liquid.
Lay bacon flat on the cutting board and use a sharp knife to cut bacon in thirds.
Wrap each pineapple piece with a piece of bacon, secure the ends together with a toothpick.
Place each completed piece on a baking sheet or cutting board, until all pineapple chunks are wrapped.
Transfer bites to the air fryer basket, in a single layer without stacking or overlapping.
Air fry at 400 degrees F for 8-12 minutes, until bacon strips reach your desired crispness. Toss bites halfway through air frying.
Optional Brown Sugar Glaze
In a small bowl, stir together the melted butter and brown sugar. Brush over bacon wrapped pieces to coat, before air frying.
ae0a88894a9159ace8d6305d.title: Air Fryer Bacon Wrapped Pineapple

ae1ab632f36b3c7aec541e34.author: Soup Loving Nicole
instructions: Using a sharp knife, make a dotted line lengthwise around the entire squash. Place whole squash in the microwave and cook on full power to help it cut more easily, about 3 to 5 minutes. Transfer to a cutting board and cut the squash in half lengthwise, using the dotted line as a guide. Wrap one half in plastic wrap and refrigerate for another use.
Spoon pulp and seeds out of remaining half and discard. Brush olive oil over all of the flesh and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Preheat an air fryer to 360 degrees F (180 degrees C). Place spaghetti squash half skin side-down in the basket. Cook until squash is tender, about 18 to 20 minutes.
Transfer to a dish and fluff with a fork to create “noodles”.
ae1ab632f36b3c7aec541e34.title: Air Fryer Spaghetti Squash

afade61dbb49323018010ee0.author: Becky
instructions: Spread a light layer of butter  or mayonnaise on one side of each piece of bread.
Assemble the sandwiches by adding one slice of cheese and one slice of ham, or preferred deli meats in between two pieces of bread, butter sides out.
Place prepared sandwiches into air fryer basket, without stacking.
Air fry at 370 degrees Fahrenheit for 10-12 minutes, until the bread is golden and reaches your desired crispness. (Flip sandwich halfway through cooking time. )
afade61dbb49323018010ee0.title: Air Fryer Grilled Ham and Cheese

afca805d049b17a4fb7f46a3.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Drain pickles in a strainer and pat them dry with paper towels to remove the excess juice.
In a small bowl add flour.
Use a second bowl to whisk eggs, water and hot sauce together.
In a medium bowl combine the bread crumbs, black pepper and dried dill.
Dredge the pickles in the flour mixture (shake off any excess flour), then dip into the egg mixture and lastly into the breadcrumbs. Coated pickle slices should be covered evenly.
Spray each pickle with cooking spray and place them in the air fryer basket in a single layer.
Cook for 5 minutes, flip and cook for an additional 4-6 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
afca805d049b17a4fb7f46a3.title: Crispy Air Fryer Dill Pickles

aff92a2f9fc6aa14c32277eb.author: Becky
instructions: Lightly spray the air fryer basket with nonstick cooking spray, line with parchment paper liner, or lightly brush with olive oil.
Place the biscuits in air fryer basket, in a single layer without stacking or overlapping, and leaving enough room in between the biscuits for them to rise as they cook.
Air fry biscuits at 340 degrees F for 10 minutes.
Turn biscuits over and air fry for an additional 2-3 minutes until biscuits are golden brown and cooked all the way through. Remove from air fryer with tongs and serve while warm.
aff92a2f9fc6aa14c32277eb.title: Air Fryer Frozen Biscuits

b035045a999ad2623769412a.author: Becky
instructions: Cut brownies into squares, about 3x3 inches in size. You can leave them in square shape, or cut into brownie circles, if you prefer.
Next, scoop your favorite ice cream over the brownie, and then shape into an ice cream dome. Place brownie and ice cream in freezer while you make the meringue topping.

In a medium bowl, beat the egg whites until small glossy peaks form. Slowly add the white sugar and cream of tartar to the egg white mixture. Keep beating until a glossy stiff peak forms and the mixture thickens.
Remove brownie and ice cream from freezer. Use a spatula or wooden spoon to spread swirls of meringue, to completely coat the ice cream and brownie, covering on all sides, leaving peaks of meringue.
Place each dessert in the air fryer basket, lined with air fryer parchment paper, a small baking dish or in small ramekins that will fit in your air fryer basket.
Air fry at 400 degrees F for 3-5 minutes, until the meringue is golden brown and firm.
Serve immediately or freeze. (Freezing may make the meringue lose some of it's crisp)
b035045a999ad2623769412a.title: Air Fryer Brownie Baked Alaska

b0801219844db7ef5dd12aa6.author: France Cevallos
instructions: Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, Dijon mustard, garlic, salt, and pepper together in a bowl. Set marinade aside.
Place chicken thighs into a large resealable plastic bag. Pour marinade over chicken and seal bag, making sure to cover all parts of chicken. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Preheat an air fryer to 360 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Remove chicken from marinade and pat dry with paper towels. Place chicken pieces in the air fryer basket, cooking in batches if necessary.

Fry until chicken is no longer pink at the bone and the juices run clear, 22 to 24 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted near the bone should read 165 degrees F (74 degrees C). Squeeze a lemon wedge over each piece upon serving.
b0801219844db7ef5dd12aa6.title: Keto Lemon-Garlic Chicken Thighs in the Air Fryer

b1824661f456e34adc069dbf.author: Soup Loving Nicole
b1824661f456e34adc069dbf.title: Air Fryer Chicken Katsu with Homemade Katsu Sauce

b2765c5de6b1112c916bfae7.author: Nicole Russell
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 390 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Rinse peels and pat dry with paper towels. Place peels in a mixing bowl. Add oil, salt, and onion powder; toss to coat.
Place seasoned peels in the basket of the air fryer (you may need to work in batches). Cook 10 minutes, shaking every 2 minutes.
Let cool 1 minute and transfer to serving plate. Serve with ketchup or preferred dipping sauce.
b2765c5de6b1112c916bfae7.title: Air Fryer Potato Peel Chips

b31b3e13900b53cfea0ddf21.author: Jen
instructions: Cut, peel, and wash carrots into ½-inch angled slices.
Cut the head of the broccoli into bite-sized florets.
Add broccoli and carrots into a large mixing bowl.
Add in the tablespoons of olive oil/avocado oil, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper. Mix together till the broccoli and carrots are coated.

Transfer the seasoned vegetables to the air fryer basket and cook at 390F for 10 minutes flipping halfway through. You will have to do these in batches. Also make sure the carrots are in a single layer and not stacked on top of each other.
Remove from the air fryer basket and serve.
b31b3e13900b53cfea0ddf21.title: Air Fryer Broccoli and Carrots

b364794cc23b5887440eecdf.author: Angela Sackett Superhotmama
ingredients: 2 large sweet potato, cut into small cubes
2 slices bacon, cut into small pieces
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

Toss sweet potato, bacon, olive oil, paprika, salt, pepper, and dill in a large bowl. Place mixture into the preheated air fryer. Cook for 12 to 16 minutes. Check and stir after 10 minutes and then every 3 minutes until crispy and browned.
b364794cc23b5887440eecdf.title: Air Fryer Sweet Potato Hash

b4464f5b53f6a49b1801a26a.author: Jen
ingredients: 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese (plus extra for topping before serving)
instructions: Thaw and squeeze out excess liquid from the spinach.
Drain and chop the artichokes into small pieces.
Combine cream cheese, mayo, sour cream, and mozzarella cheese.
Fold in the spinach and artichokes into the cream cheese mixture.
Transfer to an air fryer-safe dish, top with additional cheese, and air fry at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 10-12 minutes.
b4464f5b53f6a49b1801a26a.title: Air Fryer Artichoke Spinach Dip

b4ca8469b4043eb4447f234e.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 390 degrees Fahrenheit. Prepare the air fryer basket with nonstick cooking oil if needed.
Cut the raw chicken breasts into bite sized pieces.
Add the paprika, brown sugar, and garlic powder in a small bowl and mix until combined. Set aside.
Coat the chicken bites in olive oil and then toss the chicken pieces in the brown sugar mixture.
Take each slice of bacon and cut the bacon strips in half to fit the chicken bites.
Wrap each of the seasoned chicken bites with a piece of bacon.

Place each bacon wrapped piece of chicken in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Cook at 390 degrees Fahrenheit for 8-9 minutes, or until you have crispy bacon and the internal temperature has reached 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Carefully remove the chicken bites from the Air Fryer and serve with your favorite dipping sauce such as barbecue sauce.
b4ca8469b4043eb4447f234e.title: Air Fryer Bacon Wrapped Chicken Bites

b53001fe5fd58f1f6b0b53bc.author: Yoly
instructions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the air fryer to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Line the basket with parchment paper.
Place asparagus spears in the prepared basket and mist with avocado oil. Sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, pepper, and pepper flakes. Top with Parmesan cheese.
Air-fry until asparagus spears start to char, 7 to 9 minutes.
b53001fe5fd58f1f6b0b53bc.title: Air Fryer Asparagus

b55f24dc2342d25e37882914.author: Becky
instructions: Clean mushrooms to remove loose dirt, and then pat dry with a paper towel or clean kitchen towel.
Using three shallow bowls, fill one with bread crumbs, paprika, salt and pepper. Stir seasonings with bread crumbs to combine. Fill 2nd bowl with flour,  and the 3rd bowl with the beaten eggs.
Dredge mushrooms in flour to coat, shaking off excess flour. Next, dip into the whisked egg mixture, and finally into the bread crumb mixture, giving it a light coating. Gently tap off excess crumbs.
Place the battered mushrooms into the lightly sprayed Air Fryer basket. You can also line the basket with parchment paper for easy clean up of excess batter.
Cook mushrooms using Air Fry at 380ºF for 8-10 minutes, turning the mushrooms halfway through cooking process until golden brown.
b55f24dc2342d25e37882914.title: Mushrooms in Air Fryer

b640babde9e9f95cc00ce58d.author: Becky
instructions: In a small shallow bowl mix the sugar and cinnamon together, and then set aside.

Open the can of refrigerated biscuits and separate, then lay them on a flat surface. To make them into a donut shape, use a donut cutter, biscuit cutter, apple corer, or a 1-inch round cutter, to cut a small hole in the center of each biscuit. Set the inside piece aside to make donut holes later.
Lightly spray the basket with air fryer safe non-stick cooking spray. You can also line your basket with air fryer parchment paper.

Transfer Donuts to the air fryer basket. Lay them in a single layer, work in batches as necessary. I only cook 4 donuts at a time. Air Fry at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 6-7 minutes, until golden brown.
Once they are done cooking, brush donuts on both sides with the melted butter and then dip the donuts into the cinnamon sugar to coat.
b640babde9e9f95cc00ce58d.title: Air Fryer Donuts

b6a04894157dea1c7844fbca.author: Becky
instructions: In a small bowl combine oil, sugar, cinnamon and vanilla.

Wash and pat apples dry with paper towels. Use a paring knife to peel skin off and cut apples into quarters. Then cut the thin piece of core off of each individual piece. Cut apples again into slices (half-moon shapes).
Once the apples are sliced, add apple slices to the bowl mix and lightly toss them in the mixture until all slices are fully coated.

Preheat air fryer to 380 degrees F 3-5 minutes. Place apples in a single layer a Pyrex, Corning ware, or large ramekin bowl, and place in the air fryer basket. Air fry for 10-15 minutes, until the apples are soft and golden brown.
Allow apples to cool for 2-3 minutes and then serve immediately.
b6a04894157dea1c7844fbca.title: Air Fryer Apples

b72f04c0f44a0c6fb6074c13.author: Jen
instructions: Roll out the refrigerated pie dough on a cutting board and cut them into 6" dough circles.
Use a mini pie maker, round cookie cutter or a small plate as a template for the desired size.
In a medium-sized bowl mix the cherry pie filling and cream cheese together.
Whisk the egg in a separate shallow bowl.
Scoop 2 tablespoons of the cherry cream cheese mixture into the center of the dough circles.
Fold the circle in half, then use a fork to crimp the edges.
Spritz the air fryer basket with cooking spray.
Place pies in a single layer into the prepared air fryer basket, then brush each pie with the egg mixture.
Air fry the pies at 380 degrees F for 6 minutes, flipping the pies carefully halfway through the cooking process.
Remove pies and place them on baking racks so the pies remain crispy prior to serving.
Serve while warm.
b72f04c0f44a0c6fb6074c13.title: Air Fryer Cream Cheese Cherry Pies

b8223efa120098aec935b6ab.author: France Cevallos
instructions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the air fryer to 390 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Rinse and dry salmon fillets with a paper towel. Mist fillets with cooking spray.
Mix together Cajun seasoning and brown sugar in a small bowl until combined; spread onto a plate.
Press fillets, flesh-side down, into seasoning mixture.
Spray the basket of the air fryer with cooking spray and place salmon fillets skin-side down. Mist salmon again lightly with cooking spray.
Close the lid and cook in the preheated air fryer for 8 minutes. Remove from the air fryer and let rest for 2 minutes before serving.
b8223efa120098aec935b6ab.title: Cajun Air Fryer Salmon

b913787d193f0b46afcbc65a.author: Becky
ingredients: 1 tablespoon fresh garlic (about 2-3 garlic cloves, pressed)
instructions: Let meat rest at room temperature on the counter for about 30 minutes.
Pat beef tenderloin dry with paper towels, and then brush or drizzle oil on each tenderloin.
In a small bowl, salt, garlic, and black pepper. Rub spices on both sides of tenderloin.
Place tenderloin into the Air Fryer basket. Cook steak in the Air Fryer at 400º degrees F for 13-15 minutes, turning halfway through the cooking time. Use a meat thermometer to check for doneness.
Let steak rest in its own juice for 5-10 minutes before serving to complete the cooking process.
b913787d193f0b46afcbc65a.title: Air Fryer Beef Tenderloin

b96e8e9107fa9ff24ea40f3e.author: Becky Abbott
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 380 degrees F.
While the air fryer is preheating, in a small bowl, combine the melted butter, kosher salt, and ground black pepper, then set the bowl aside.
Once the air fryer is done preheating, lightly spray the basket with olive oil or a non-stick cooking spray of your choice.
Place the corn in air fryer basket, in a single layer, and then air fry corn at 380 degrees F for 6-8 minutes.
After the 6-8 minutes, open the air fryer, and carefully brush the melted butter and seasonings on the corn, turning to coat both sides of the corn cobs.

Return basket to the air fryer and continue air frying at 380 degrees F for an additional 3-5 minutes, or until the corn has reached your desired crispness. Remove corn with tongs when done as it will be hot.
b96e8e9107fa9ff24ea40f3e.title: Air Fryer Frozen Corn on the Cob

babb28546861f8b3d49b7683.author: bdweld
ingredients: 0.25 pound breakfast sausage, fully cooked and crumbled
0.5 cup shredded Cheddar-Monterey Jack cheese blend
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 360 degrees F (180 degrees C). Spray a nonstick 6x2-inch cake pan with cooking spray.
Combine sausage, eggs, cheese, bell pepper, green onion, and cayenne pepper in a large bowl; mix well to combine.
Pour egg mixture into the prepared cake pan.
Cook in the preheated air fryer until frittata is set, 18 to 20 minutes.
babb28546861f8b3d49b7683.title: Air Fryer Breakfast Frittata

bba45d81639156c5a2edd69a.author: Becky
instructions: In a medium sized bowl, combine the  dry ingredients of flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and nutmeg, then set aside.

In a large mixing bowl, beat together the sugar, brown sugar, eggs, and teaspoon vanilla extract. Once combined, add the oil and orange juice, then slowly add in the dry mixture, until well combined. Scrape the sides of the bowl to make sure all ingredients are incorporated. Mix on medium speed until you have a smooth batter.
Stir in the shredded carrot, and if using, add optional shredded coconut and chopped walnuts. Continue to stir until all ingredients are well combined.

Prepare an 8 inch round cake pan, by lining the bottom of the pan with a circle of parchment paper. Then lightly spray or butter the sides of the pan. Pour the carrot cake batter into lightly greased or lined cake pan.

Place cake pan in air fryer basket and air fry at 320ºF for 20 minutes. Cover the cake with foil, and then continue to air fry for an additional 10 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted into the center of the cake.
bba45d81639156c5a2edd69a.title: Air Fryer Carrot Cake

bd14e9f32d67e58903c07ff8.author: Soup Loving Nicole
ingredients: 14 ounces giant white corn (such as Goya®)
instructions: Gather all ingredients.
Place corn in a large bowl and cover with water; let sit to rehydrate, 8 hours to overnight.
Drain corn and spread out in an even layer on a large baking sheet. Pat dry with paper towels. Air-dry for 20 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Place corn in a large bowl. Add oil and salt; stir until evenly coated.

Working in batches, place corn into the air fryer basket in an even layer and cook in the preheated air fryer for 10 minutes. Shake the basket and cook for 10 more minutes. Shake the basket again, cook for 5 more minutes, then transfer corn nuts to a paper towel-lined plate. Repeat with remaining corn.
Allow corn nuts to cool until crisp before serving, about 20 minutes.
bd14e9f32d67e58903c07ff8.title: Air Fryer Corn Nuts

be09359880abf3d8b489a9a4.author: Allrecipes
ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemon juice, or more to taste
instructions: Sprinkle cut sides of eggplant with salt. Let stand for 20 to 30 minutes. Blot dry with paper towels.
Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

Brush cut sides of eggplant with 1 tablespoon olive oil. Cut off the top 1/4 inch from the garlic bulb, exposing the cloves. Brush cloves with 1/2 tablespoon olive oil and wrap bulb in aluminum foil. Place eggplant and garlic in the air fryer basket.
Cook in the preheated air fryer until eggplant and garlic are tender and eggplant is deep golden brown, 15 to 20 minutes. Remove and allow to cool, about 10 minutes.

Scoop flesh from eggplant and place into the bowl of a food processor. Add tahini, lemon juice, 4 cloves of roasted garlic (reserve remaining roasted garlic for another use), remaining 4 tablespoons olive oil, cumin, and paprika; pulse to a moderately smooth consistency. Top with feta cheese, parsley, and lemon zest.
be09359880abf3d8b489a9a4.title: Air Fryer Baba Ganoush

bf272a80c8ffa89a7c6498d5.author: Becky
ingredients: 1 pound chicken (cut into strips or cubes)
1 1/2 cups unsweetened coconut flakes (or shredded coconut)
instructions: Pat chicken dry with paper towel, then cut chicken into strips or cubes.
Beat the eggs in a shallow bowl and set aside.
In a second shallow or small bowl combine the coconut flour mixture, paprika, salt and pepper and in a third bowl mix the coconut flakes with panko breadcrumbs.
Dredge each piece of chicken into coconut flour mixture, then dip into the egg mixture and lastly into the coconut and panko.
Completely cover entire surface of chicken for extra crunchy texture. And gently shake off any excess coconut so they will cook evenly, and coconut flakes won't burn.
Prepare air fryer basket with non- stick cooking spray or air fryer parchment paper.
Place the coconut chicken in a single layer into air fryer basket and cook for 12-14 minutes at 380 degrees Fahrenheit. Flip halfway through cooking time.
Remove when golden brown and serve immediately.
bf272a80c8ffa89a7c6498d5.title: Air Fryer Coconut Chicken

bf46f4a695d778bfeaed75d6.author: France Cevallos
ingredients: 1 pound skinless salmon fillets, cut into 1-inch pieces
1.5 teaspoons seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
1 pinch seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
instructions: Make Sriracha mayo: Whisk together mayonnaise and Sriracha in a small bowl. Place 1 tablespoon Sriracha mayo in the bowl of a food processor and refrigerate the rest until ready to use.

Prepare salmon cakes: Add salmon, almond flour, egg, green onion, and 1 1/2 teaspoons seafood seasoning to Sriracha mayo in the bowl of a food processor; pulse quickly for 4 to 5 seconds until ingredients are just combined, but small chunks of salmon remain. (Do not overprocess as the mixture will become mushy.)
Line a plate with waxed paper and spray hands with cooking spray. Form salmon mixture into 8 small patties; transfer to the plate. Place in the refrigerator until chilled and firm, about 15 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 390 degrees F (200 degrees C). Spray the air fryer basket with cooking spray.
Remove salmon cakes from refrigerator. Mist both sides with cooking spray and gently place in the air fryer basket, working in batches if necessary to avoid overcrowding.
Cook in the preheated air fryer for 6 to 8 minutes. Place on a serving platter and serve with remaining Sriracha mayo and a light sprinkling of Old Bay seasoning.
bf46f4a695d778bfeaed75d6.title: Keto Air Fryer Salmon Cakes with Sriracha Mayo

bff0eb42d11d6421d78fc140.author: Jen
instructions: Cut the wings into pieces so that you have 24 wings.
Place the wings in a large bowl and add olive oil, garlic powder, and baking powder. Mix well. Cover and refrigerate, then allow the wings to marinate for 30 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 400°F (200°C). Prepare the air fryer basket after preheating.
Add the seasoned wings in a single layer to the air fryer basket.

Air Fry Wings at 400°F (204°C) for 20 minutes, flipping the wings halfway through. Air fry an additional 2 minutes for extra crispy skin. Use a digital meat thermometer to ensure the internal temperature is 165 degrees F.
Carefully remove the air fryer wings from the air fryer, cover with your favorite sauce, and serve with your favorite sides.
bff0eb42d11d6421d78fc140.title: Crispy Air Fryer Chicken Wings

c01812784de080e273b35607.author: Becky
ingredients: 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted ((half a stick))
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, sugar, and cinnamon in a bowl.
Pour in the milk, melted butter, egg, and vanilla. Stir together with a fork until all of the ingredients are well combined.
Gently fold in the blueberries to the batter, until they are evenly distributed.
Using a portion scoop, fill the silicone cups about 3/4 of the way. If using a small muffin tin, fill paper liners 3/4 of the way.
Gently place into the basket. Air fry at 350 degrees F for 4-6 minutes.
c01812784de080e273b35607.title: Air Fryer Blueberry Muffin Bites

c15ce6dae25a39fb3a3d0b1e.author: Jen
instructions: Combine the flour, paprika, salt, black pepper, white pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and baking powder in a large shallow bowl. Whisk together and set aside.
Combine the milk, egg, and hot sauce in a second bowl. Mix well.
Take the fresh cube steaks and dip them into the dry mixture, the egg mixture, and then back into the flour mixture.
Repeat this with your cube steaks and place them on a baking sheet.
Spray both sides of the prepared cube steaks with a few spritzes of oil cooking spray.
Prepare the Air Fryer basket with olive oil cooking spray or perforated parchment paper.
Place the cube steaks in a single layer in the air fryer basket and cook at 400ºF. for 8 minutes.
Use a spatula to flip each steak carefully, spray once more with olive oil spray, and cook for another 5-6 minutes until the tops are golden brown with a crispy coating.
Serve with white gravy, green beans, corn, cornbread, or any of your favorite side dishes.
c15ce6dae25a39fb3a3d0b1e.title: Air Fryer Chicken Fried Steak

c15d6b93769a155f66879895.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat the Air fryer to 370° F.
In a small bowl, combine cream cheese, green onions, crab meat, salt, pepper, and minced garlic. Stir to mix well.
Place the wonton wrappers on a flat surface.
Dip your fingertip into a small bowl of warm water and run it onto the outside edges of the wrapper.
Add a teaspoon of the crab mixture into the center of the wrapper.

Fold each wrapper into a square. In order to do this, you need to grab the opposite corners and pinch them into the middle, making sure they are sealed. When sealing the edges of the wonton, make sure to push out any additional air from the wrappers.
Place the sealed crab rangoon into the air fryer basket. Spray the tops of the crab rangoon with cooking spray or olive oil spray.
Air fry at 370 degrees F for 9-10 minutes, or until the wonton wrappers have turned a nice golden brown.
Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
c15d6b93769a155f66879895.title: Air Fryer Crab Rangoon

c1c49f8aadbe77eba9655273.author: Jen
instructions: Rinse and clean the artichokes.
Remove outer leaves, cut the tips and shorten the stem with a sharp knife or kitchen scissors.
Cut them in half, lengthwise, and turn the artichoke halves so they are flat side up.
Place them in a baking dish.
Drizzle fresh lemon juice generously over entire artichoke half.
Next drizzle all 4 halves with olive oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Place each halved artichoke in air fryer basket, in a single layer, flat side down.
Air fry artichokes at 340 degrees F for 12-15 minutes until cooked (a knife should be able to cut through the flesh easily and they will have soft leaves).
Serve artichokes while hot.
c1c49f8aadbe77eba9655273.title: Air Fryer Artichoke

instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 390 degrees Fahrenheit or 198 degrees Celcius. Prepare the basket with a nonstick cooking spray, [archment paper, or foil after your air fryer has been preheated.

Place the frozen mozzarella cheese sticks in a single layer in the prepared air fryer basket. Make sure to leave enough room around the cheese sticks to allow the hot air to fully circulate around the cheese sticks.
Air Fry the frozen cheese sticks for 5-7 minutes, flipping the cheese sticks halfway through cooking.
Carefully remove the air fryer cheese sticks from the basket of the air fryer and serve with marinara for dipping.
c3e4a134c0f25cc338adbbfd.title: Air Fryer Frozen Mozzarella Sticks

c59a0ab74f32fffeaf8a57b3.author: France Cevallos
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 390 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Place tomatoes and jalapeno skin-side down into the air fryer basket, along with red onion. Lightly spray vegetables with cooking spray to help the roasting process.
Air fry vegetables for 5 minutes. Open basket and add garlic cloves. Spray lightly with cooking spray and air fry for an additional 5 minutes.
Transfer vegetables to a cutting board and allow to cool for 10 minutes.

Remove skins from tomatoes and jalapeno, if desired; they should slip right off. Chop tomatoes, jalapeno, and onion into large chunks and add to the bowl of a food processor. Add garlic, cilantro, lime juice, and salt. Pulse several times until vegetables are finely chopped; do not over-process. Serve at room temperature or refrigerate to let flavors meld.
c59a0ab74f32fffeaf8a57b3.title: Air Fryer Roasted Salsa

c5a9a8c6fd2b87bc58900325.title: Air Fryer Bacon Wrapped Chicken Bites

c5f404f0b824f77df2d8a853.author: Becky
instructions: Use a sharp knife cut to remove the stem and then cut into bite size cauliflower florets. You can also start with 3 cups of fresh cauliflower already cut.
Place the florets into a medium mixing bowl. Toss cauliflower with olive oil and other seasonings, until fully coated.

Place seasoned cauliflower into air fryer basket. Air fry at 380 degrees Fahrenheit for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through the air frying process, until cauliflower reaches your desired crispness.
Remove cauliflower from air fryer and serve while hot. If you wanted to make these cheesy add cheese as soon as it's done air frying so it will melt evenly over cauliflower.
c5f404f0b824f77df2d8a853.title: Air Fryer Cauliflower

c64baa25f133524c0a3e608c.author: Becky
instructions: Lightly brush the steaks, on both sides, with olive oil. Then season both sides of each steak.
Lightly spray the basket with non-stick cooking spray, then carefully place steak in air fryer basket, making sure pieces aren't stacking or overlapping.
Air fry at 400 degrees F for 5-7 minutes cooking time, until the internal temperature reaches 145 degrees F. Use a meat thermometer to confirm doneness.
Let the meat rest in their juices for about 5-10 minutes
c64baa25f133524c0a3e608c.title: Air Fryer Cube Steak

c6cc08f8b3edf4148c4a417c.author: Becky
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 400°F
Place the frozen okra in the air fryer basket. Keep it in a single layer and spread it out evenly. Make sure to leave some space between pieces, as this will help them cook more evenly.
Spray the okra pieces lightly with cooking spray or oil of your choice. I give the okra a light spray before air frying so it would crisp up a little more.
Air fry okra at 400 degrees F for 8-12 minutes, or until the okra is a golden brown color and crispy on the outside. Shake basket after 6 minutes of cook time.
Remove from the air fryer and enjoy! Serve with your favorite dipping sauce, such as ranch dressing, marinara sauce, or honey mustard.
c6cc08f8b3edf4148c4a417c.title: Air Fryer Frozen Okra

c70c1d03d206733d235e733b.author: Soup Loving Nicole
instructions: Gather the ingredients. Preheat an air fryer to 360 degrees F (180 degrees C) according to manufacturer's instructions.
Whisk olive oil, Italian seasoning, poultry seasoning, paprika, and salt together in a small bowl.
Pat chicken dry using paper towels. Brush spice mixture over entire chicken, including underneath the wings.

Place chicken in the basket of the air fryer breast side down; cook, undisturbed, for 45 minutes. Carefully flip the chicken over using tongs; cook until an instant-read thermometer reads 165 degrees F (74 degrees C), about 20 minutes.
Remove chicken to a cutting board; let rest for 10 minutes.
c70c1d03d206733d235e733b.title: Easy Air Fryer Whole Chicken

c7a35ae697f5f82c1f8ce11a.author: Becky
ingredients: 1 pound large raw shrimp (peeled and deveined ( I use 31/40 size))
instructions: In a shallow bowl, add breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, parsley flakes, paprika, salt and pepper. Stir with a fork to combine ingredients.
