In another large bowl, add the flour, egg, and water. Stir together to make a liquid batter.
Toss shrimp with the flour and egg batter, until they are coated on both sides.
Dredge each piece of shrimp in the panko mixture, coating both sides.
Lightly spray the air fryer basket, and place each shrimp into the basket, without stacking or overlapping.
Lightly spritz the coated shrimp with olive oil and then place shrimp in the air fryer basket. Air Fry at 380 degrees F for 8-10 minutes, flipping shrimp halfway through air frying.
c7a35ae697f5f82c1f8ce11a.title: Air Fryer Breaded Shrimp

c7aba8244e528ae344b69aef.author: Becky
ingredients: 1 teaspoon chili powder (for spicier kick, use cayenne pepper)
instructions: Because the onion will be very hot, to easily remove the hot onion from the air fryer basket, use a piece of aluminum foil to make an aluminum foil sling for easy lifting.
Remove the outer skin of the onion and cut off the top, placing the cut side facing down.

Using a cutting board and a sharp knife, slice from the middle of the onion, leaving a small uncut circle in the center. Make 8-10 evenly spaced slices from top to bottom of the entire onion, and through all of the layers, leaving the center connected and root intact to the onion petals.
Place onion in ice cold water and let it sit for about 1-2 hours to soften the onion petals to help them separate to coat.
In a medium bowl, combine the flour with the spices. Add one cup of water to the dry ingredients, stirring until it forms into a batter. Add one tablespoon of water or extra flour if necessary.
Drain onion from the water, patting dry with a paper towel if needed. Open the onion slices, spreading them as much as possible without tearing the center.
Place onion in a deep bowl, and dip onion or spoon the batter over the onion, making sure to coat onion sections evenly. Shake of excess batter, and then coat the onion with breadcrumbs.
Spray your Air Fryer basket with non-stick cooking spray or line the basket with parchment paper. Place the coated onion cut-side down, in Air Fryer basket.
To help your blooming onion crisp, lightly spritz the onion petals with cooking oil spray, and air fry at 380ºF for 18-20 minutes until golden brown color with a crispy coating.
c7aba8244e528ae344b69aef.title: Air Fryer Blooming Onion

c7e6518951fbc58e2609c0a0.author: Becky
instructions: Open your container of frozen fried shrimp of whatever size suits you.
If you want to add your own seasonings first, toss the shrimp with the seasonings, then place the shrimp in air fryer basket.
Air fry pre-cooked frozen shrimp at 370 degrees Fahrenheit 6-8 minutes. If using raw shrimp, air fry for 8-10 minutes.
Take them out and enjoy them as an entrée, appetizer, or ingredient with whatever dipping sauce or meal you prefer!
c7e6518951fbc58e2609c0a0.title: Air Fryer Frozen Shrimp

c98cf80f477dda5406a21bae.author: Jen
instructions: Butter both sides of the bread and place it in a single layer in the basket of the air fryer.
Slice the tomatoes and the mozzarella cheese and alternate them on the top of the bread.
Air fry the caprese grilled cheese at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 8-9 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and starting to turn golden brown.
Carefully remove the Caprese grilled cheese from the air fryer basket and top with balsamic glaze and fresh chopped parsley.
c98cf80f477dda5406a21bae.title: Air Fryer Caprese Grilled Cheese

cb6ec585c7fae48f1e450808.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat the Air Fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Place the bacon slices in the basket of the air fryer in a single layer. (It's ok if the bacon overlaps a little)
Close the basket door and cook at 400 degrees Fahrenheit (205 degrees Celsius) for 10 minutes.
Check the bacon after 10 minutes for crispiness. If you would like the bacon to be crispier, add another minute or two of cook time.
Remove to a plate and blot with paper towels to soak up any excess grease before serving.
cb6ec585c7fae48f1e450808.title: Air Fryer Bacon

cb7418f1c60aeac8d362e055.author: Becky
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 200 degrees.
While the air fryer is preheating, prepare the walnuts, by placing them in a medium bowl with the melted butter and the vanilla.
Stir the walnuts until they are coated with the butter and vanilla, so the other ingredients will stick to them.
Once the walnuts are covered in the coating, stir in the brown sugar, sugar, cinnamon, and salt. Toss the walnuts with the other ingredients so they are evenly covered.
Finally, transfer them to your air fryer basket, and air fry at 200 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes, stirring them, or shaking the basket halfway through.
cb7418f1c60aeac8d362e055.title: Air Fryer Candied Walnuts

cbe3f3a875f7fa128214b01f.author: Becky
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 360 degrees F. If you don't have a preheat function, let it run at 360 degrees F for 3-5 minutes.
While the air fryer is preheating, lightly rinse the cod in cold water, and then pat dry with paper towels.
Brush the fillets with the olive oil, coating both sides. In a small bowl, mix the garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper together. Then evenly sprinkle both sides of each piece of cod.

Place the cod in the air fryer and air fry at 360 degrees F for 12-15 minutes. Flip them halfway through cooking time. Use a meat thermometer to check internal temperature. For cod, when fully cooked, it should be 145 degrees F.
cbe3f3a875f7fa128214b01f.title: Air Fryer Frozen Cod

cc092f5685afae907e940a3d.author: Becky
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the rolled oats, with oil, nuts, honey, sugar, brown sugar, cinnamon, and salt. Toss together to combine.
Line the air fryer basket with parchment paper, and pour granola over the lining.
Air fry at 300 degrees F for 15-18 minutes, stirring 2-3 times during the air frying process.
Transfer to a bowl or spread out on parchment paper and allow granola to cool. It will harden a bit as it cools so it breaks into small clumps.
After air frying and the granola cools, add mix-ins!
cc092f5685afae907e940a3d.title: Air Fryer Granola

cc281ebcd92ab12d90ded5f0.author: Soup Loving Nicole
ingredients: 1 tablespoon seafood seasoning (such as Old Bay®)
12 ounces large shrimp - peeled, deveined, and tails left on
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Place flour, Old Bay, paprika, salt, parsley, and black pepper in a gallon-sized resealable plastic bag. Seal and shake to combine. Place beaten eggs in a shallow bowl.

Pat shrimp dry using paper towels. Working in batches, add shrimp to seasoned flour and toss to combine. Dip shrimp in beaten eggs and then back in seasoned flour. Place breaded shrimp in the air fryer basket, making sure not to overcrowd. Lightly coat the tops with nonstick cooking spray.

Cook in the preheated air fryer for 4 minutes. Remove the lid and spray any chalky spots with nonstick cooking spray. Close the lid and continue cooking until desired crispness is reached, about 3 minutes more.
cc281ebcd92ab12d90ded5f0.title: Air Fryer Breaded Shrimp

cd8d03bb214ea390928a7171.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat the Air Fryer to 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Once preheated, spray the basket with non-stick cooking spray and add a piece of parchment paper or foil.
Take a piece of bread and a large cookie cutter and cut a hole in the center of the bread. Place the bread on the parchment paper in the Air Fryer basket.
Crack the egg and add it to the center of the slice of bread.
Close the Air Fryer Basket and heat the egg in a basket for 5 minutes on 350 degrees Fahrenheit. Add an extra minute if needed.
Remove from the Air Fryer and top with a pinch of salt and pepper before serving.
cd8d03bb214ea390928a7171.title: Air Fryer Egg in a Basket

ceb5879626c348af14e503b3.author: Jen
instructions: Prepare the air fryer basket with a nonstick cooking spray such as avocado oil or olive oil.
Take each slice of bread and butter one side of the bread.
Add peanut butter to one piece of bread and jelly to the other piece of bread.
Add the peanut butter and jelly together, and place them in a single layer in your prepared air fryer basket.
Use the air fry function and fry the sandwiches at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 3-4 minutes, flipping the sandwich halfway through the cooking time.
Remove the sandwich from the air fryer and serve immediately.
ceb5879626c348af14e503b3.title: Air Fried Peanut Butter and Jelly Sandwich

cee38a3acf319dcb773c910d.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat the Air Fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit/200 degrees Celcius.
Place the fries in a single layer into the air fryer basket and then spray a light coat of oil and then season with salt.
Air fry frozen french fries at 400 degrees F for 10 minutes, shake the fries, and then cook for an additional 8-10 minutes cooking time, depending on how crispy you like your fries.
cee38a3acf319dcb773c910d.title: Air Fryer Frozen French Fries

cffca774f66c11b4136f85f9.author: Laura Rege
cffca774f66c11b4136f85f9.title: Air Fryer Tahini Black Bean Fritters

d0b1ae2d12f18dab1551baf7.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, combine the onion, chicken, cream cheese, taco seasoning, Mexican blend cheese, and ground black pepper. Mix well.

Brush one side of each tortilla with butter. Place the butter side down. Scoop 3 Tablespoons of chicken mixture into the center of the tortilla. Fold the tortilla in and roll it closed, then secure it with a toothpick.
Repeat for the remainder of the tortillas.
Place the chimichangas in a single layer in the basket of the air fryer. Air fry at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 4 minutes, flip, and air fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the toothpicks and serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
d0b1ae2d12f18dab1551baf7.title: Air Fryer Chimichangas

d0e1d53e2f30aadadb34598d.author: Becky
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the butter, sugar, and brown sugar. Beat the butter with sugars until smooth and creamy.
Add eggs, vanilla, salt, baking soda, and half of the flour. Mix until the dry ingredients have combined with the butter mixture.

Add in the remaining half of the flour and mix on medium speed, until the cookie dough is thick and creamy. Once the dough is mixed, stir in the chocolate chips, and optional nuts, until they are evenly distributed throughout the dough.
Use a small cookie scoop or spoon to shape the dough into balls. Place the dough balls into the air fryer basket on top of parchment paper. Leave about an inch in between each cookie.
Air Fry at 300 degrees F for 7-8 minutes. When cookies are golden brown, let them sit in the air fryer basket for an additional 1 to 2 minutes before transferring to cooling rack.
d0e1d53e2f30aadadb34598d.title: Air Fryer Chocolate Chip Cookies

d12f1cacfd51b7805f274e15.author: Becky
ingredients: 1  Nestle Toll House Cookie Dough (16.5 ounce package)
instructions: Line the springform pan with parchment paper.
Separate the cookies and spread them out  in the bottom of the springform pan.
Cook at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 8-10 minutes.
While the cookies are in the air fryer, prepare the filling.
In a large mixing bowl, add in the cream cheese,  mix until it is smooth and creamy.
Add in the powdered sugar, eggs, and vanilla, and continue mixing on medium speed until the ingredients have completely mixed into the cream cheese filling.
Stir in 3/4 cup chocolate chips, making sure they are evenly distributed throughout the filling.
Pour the filling over the cookie crust, spreading evenly. Sprinkle 1/4 cup of chocolate chips on top of the cheesecake.
Cook in the air fryer at 300 degrees Fahrenheit  for 15-18 minutes.
Chill until cool and the filling has set. (About 4-6 hours)
d12f1cacfd51b7805f274e15.title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Cheesecake

d1eaa45f9adbd6ce3bf194c0.author: Jen
instructions: Add six eggs to the basket of the air fryer. You can also use a trivet to keep the eggs from moving around.
Set the temperature to 270 degrees Fahrenheit, and the cooking time to 17 minutes.
Carefully remove the eggs from the air fryer and completely submerge them directly into a bowl of ice water.
Let the eggs sit in the ice bath for 10 minutes.
Carefully remove the outer shell of the egg.
Once the shells are removed, slice the eggs in half, lengthwise.
Take the yellow yolks and place them into a small bowl.
Add the flour into a small bowl and the panko breadcrumbs into a separate small bowl.
Take the two uncooked eggs and whisk them together into a small bowl.
Dip the egg whites into the flour, then into the whisked eggs, and then into the panko breadcrumbs. Once they’ve all been dipped, spray and coat them with love oil spray.
Place the breaded egg whites into the basket of the air fryer and air fry at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 3 minutes, flip, and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
To make the filling, use a fork, mash the yellow yolks until they are crumbled into small pieces. Add the mayonnaise, mustard, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Use a Tablespoon, scoop the yellow egg mixture back into the fried egg whites. Garnish with paprika for a classic look, and sprinkle with fresh parsley flakes for a little color.
d1eaa45f9adbd6ce3bf194c0.title: Air Fryer Deviled Eggs

d3d6ca37133be0409130e74e.author: Becky
instructions: Lightly brush or spray the air fryer basket with olive oil or line with parchment paper. Place the fish fingers in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Work in batches to avoid overlapping in the basket.
Air Fry at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 10-12 minutes cook time, flipping halfway through cooking time.
Once the outside is golden brown and crispy, remove fish sticks from basket. Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
d3d6ca37133be0409130e74e.title: Air Fryer Frozen Fish Sticks

d49faee4ae1f26b02e81418e.author: Becky
instructions: Preheat your air fryer to 380°F.
Place the frozen crab cakes in the air fryer basket, without stacking or overlapping.
Air fry crab cakes for 10-12 minutes, until golden brown and crispy on the outside and heated through on the inside.
Serve with your favorite sauce such as tartar sauce, hot sauce, a pinch of lemon juice, or cocktail sauce.
d49faee4ae1f26b02e81418e.title: Air Fryer Frozen Crab Cakes

d5b74df4556eb5a335ee3788.title: Air Fryer Fried Shrimp Sandwich with Tartar Sauce

d7bb8b1810e04ecf452cf6a5.title: Air Fryer Bacon Wrapped Pork Tenderloin

d7e5aa19b38d1fa96efd0c79.author: Becky
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the eggs, brown sugar, milk, cinnamon, vanilla and salt. Whisk to combine.
Cut the bread into bite sized pieces, then add to the bowl with the egg batter.  Toss the cubes until they are evenly coated. Make sure there are no dry spots on the bread pieces.
Lightly spray non stick spray on the bottom of an air fryer rack. Place bread cubes in the air fryer basket, in a single layer, careful not to overlap.
Air Fry at 350 degrees F for 8-10 minutes until golden brown, shaking halfway through. Serve with your favorite toppings and enjoy!
d7e5aa19b38d1fa96efd0c79.title: Air Fryer French Toast Bites

d819f38da8a319515e7cb45e.author: Taste of Home Editorial Team
d819f38da8a319515e7cb45e.title: Air-Fryer Pumpkin Biscuits with Spiced Apple Butter

d86812b60c4a5deaeba4919d.author: Yoly
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 300 degrees F (150 degrees C). Line the air fryer basket with aluminum foil.
Pour melted butter into the lined basket. Whisk sugar, egg white, and cinnamon together in a bowl. Add pecans; toss until fully coated. Spread out in the lined basket.
Air fry for 5 minutes; shake basket and air fry 5 minutes more. Shake basket again; air fry 2 to 4 minutes more.
d86812b60c4a5deaeba4919d.title: Air Fryer Sugared Pecans

da1e61b6ac44e85d01e4844d.author: Becky
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine the flour, baking soda, ginger, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt in a bowl, then set the bowl aside.
In a large bowl, or stand mixer, add the butter and sugar. Beat together at medium speed. Add in the egg, vanilla, and molasses. Continue mixing on medium speed until well combined.
Slowly, add in the flour mixture, and continue mixing until all ingredients are combined. Scrape the inside of the bowl if needed.
Wrap and chill dough for about 30 minutes.
On a lightly floured surface, roll the dough about 1/4 inch in thickness. Use cookie cutters to cut into your favorite shapes.
Place cookies in the air fryer basket, lined with parchment paper.
Air fry at 350 degrees F for 8-10 minutes until dough is cooked.
Allow cookies to cool for 2-3 minutes before removing from the air fryer basket. Then transfer cookies to a wire rack to cool completely.
da1e61b6ac44e85d01e4844d.title: Gingerbread Cookies in the Air Fryer

da24f06fcf17bcaff3756c1a.author: Becky
ingredients: ¼ cup blueberries (fresh or frozen, cut into half if larger in size)
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine cream cheese, sugar, sour cream and vanilla. Stir together until well blended and smooth. Add blueberries and gently fold into the cream cheese mixture.

Lay wonton wrappers flat, and spoon a small amount of the mixture into the center of the wonton. Brush the edges of the wonton wrapper with water and then bring sides together to make a small pillow shape square.
Place filled wontons in a lightly sprayed air fryer basket, without stacking or overlapping. Lightly spray the wontons with olive oil spray to help with crispness and color.
Air fry at 350 degrees F for 6-8 minutes until wontons are golden and crispy.
Remove from the air fryer basket and sprinkle with a light dusting of powdered sugar.
da24f06fcf17bcaff3756c1a.title: Air Fryer Blueberry Cheesecake Wontons

da42bcb6a14ccd7ab363b3ad.author: Yoly
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) according to manufacturer's instructions. Grease 2 individual ramekins.

Combine chocolate chips and butter in a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave on high for 1 minute; stir. Continue microwaving at 15-second intervals until almost melted; stir until chocolate is completely melted and thoroughly combined.

Whisk confectioners' sugar, egg, egg yolk, vanilla extract, and salt into melted chocolate until combined. Whisk in flour until incorporated. Pour batter into the prepared ramekins; place in the air fryer basket. Cover the ramekins with large pieces of aluminum foil, tucking ends underneath to prevent foil from flying off.
Cook in the preheated air fryer for 8 to 10 minutes. Remove foil and continue cooking until edges are set, 2 to 4 minutes more.
Transfer ramekins to a heat-proof work surface; set aside for 5 minutes. Invert cakes onto dessert plates. Serve hot.
da42bcb6a14ccd7ab363b3ad.title: Air Fryer Lava Cakes Recipe

da62aed4d8d86d32fcba7f1a.author: FrackFamily5 CACT
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Season mahi mahi fillets with salt and pepper and spray with cooking spray on both sides. Place fillets in the air fryer basket, making sure to leave space in between.
Cook in the preheated air fryer until fish flakes easily with a fork and has a golden hue, about 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, melt butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat; bring to a simmer and cook until butter turns frothy and a rich brown color, 3 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Transfer fish fillets to a plate and drizzle with brown butter.
da62aed4d8d86d32fcba7f1a.title: Air Fryer Mahi Mahi with Brown Butter

db2238b7d1aa56bae2df7956.author: Becky
ingredients: 2 teaspoons minced garlic (or 1 teaspoon garlic powder)
instructions: To make this easy air fryer recipe, use a sharp vegetable peeler and peel the butternut squash skin. Use a sharp chef knife, and cut squash halves, lengthwise, and then remove all seeds.
Cut the squash into cubes about the size of dice. I try to do 1-inch cubes. You can skip the steps if you use pre-cut butternut squash cubes.
In a medium or large bowl, add the butternut squash cubes, and toss the squash with olive oil and seasonings.
Once pieces of squash are well coated, in a single layer, pour seasoned squash pieces into the air fryer basket.
Cook butternut squash on Air Fry, at 400 degrees F for 16 to 18 minutes cook time, until squash is crispy and tender to your liking. Shake the basket halfway during the cooking process.
Season cooked squash with additional salt and pepper to taste.
db2238b7d1aa56bae2df7956.title: Air Fryer Butternut Squash

db61bfb37098ed18cb2c3dd1.author: Becky
instructions: Rinse corn and pat dry.
Brush each ear of corn with melted butter. Then season with salt and pepper, to your taste.
Place corn in the air fryer basket or on shelf.
Air fry at 400 degrees F for 12 minutes, turning corn halfway through cooking.
db61bfb37098ed18cb2c3dd1.title: Air Fryer Corn on the Cob

dcb657239b4acf54c8129449.author: Becky
instructions: To make this recipe, begin by unrolling crescent dough and separating each crescent roll.
Place one peanut butter cup at the end of the crescent roll and roll until it is completely wrapped. Be sure to pinch dough to cover and seal any exposed parts of the chocolate.
Spray Air Fryer basket with nonstick cooking spray, or line with Air Fryer parchment paper. Place wrapped peanut butter cups in the prepared basket, leaving a small space between each pastry.
Air fry at 350 degrees for about 5-7 minutes, until crescent rolls are golden brown.
Carefully remove them from the Air Fryer. Dust tops with powdered sugar, drizzle with chocolate syrup or frosting glaze.
dcb657239b4acf54c8129449.title: Air Fried Peanut Butter Cups

ddf8515e160d878f08bc22f1.author: lutzflcat
ingredients: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
1 tablespoon olive oil, or as needed
instructions: Season tomatoes with salt and pepper.
Place flour into a shallow dish. Beat buttermilk and eggs together in a second shallow dish. Mix panko bread crumbs, cornmeal, garlic powder, and paprika together in a third dish.
Dredge tomato slices in flour, shaking off excess. Dip in egg mixture, then press both sides into cornmeal mixture.
Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Brush the fryer basket with olive oil.
Working in batches, place breaded tomatoes in the prepared fryer basket, ensuring they do not touch each other. Brush the tops of tomatoes with olive oil.

Cook in the preheated air fryer for 12 minutes, flip tomatoes, and brush again with olive oil. Continue cooking until crisp and golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes more. Remove tomatoes to a paper towel-lined rack to keep crisp. Repeat with remaining tomatoes.
ddf8515e160d878f08bc22f1.title: Air Fryer Fried Green Tomatoes

de673a5b46c4a5536b6ed8d6.author: Jen
ingredients: 1 cup fish fry breading (I prefer Louisiana brand)
instructions: Preheat the Air Fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 5 minutes.
Rinse and dry the catfish with a paper towel before coating.
Add the seasoned breading to a shallow bowl and then dip each piece of fish until coated completely. Spray the sides of each fillet with olive oil spray.
Place fillets in the prepared Air Fryer basket in a single layer. Cook at 400ºF for 10 minutes, then carefully flip the catfish filets and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Flip once more and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes to get them extra crispy if desired.
Serve with coleslaw and tartar sauce. Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the filets just before serving.
de673a5b46c4a5536b6ed8d6.title: Air Fryer Catfish

df5757d66d58254a72bf6cfa.author: Nicole McLaughlin
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon finely crushed dried parsley flakes
instructions: Place a cheese stick at the bottom third of each tortilla. Tuck the sides in and roll up. Use a toothpick to secure the tortilla closed if necessary.
Brush each roll with olive oil and sprinkle lightly with garlic powder and dried parsley.
Fry in an air fryer at 400 degrees F (200 degrees C) until just browned and toasted, about 5 minutes.
Serve with marinara if desired.
df5757d66d58254a72bf6cfa.title: Air Fryer 2-Ingredient Mozzarella Sticks

e09bf36c46026395a7f20c0f.author: Laura Rege
e09bf36c46026395a7f20c0f.title: Air Fryer Spinach and Artichoke Stuffed Chicken Breast

e0b18245413eacb745a6e04b.author: Nicole Russell
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Meanwhile, place potatoes in a microwave-safe bowl: cook on high until just tender, about 5 minutes.
Transfer potatoes to a baking sheet and use the bottom of a small glass to gently "smash" them to 3/4 or 1/2-inch thick. The thinner you flatten the potatoes, the crispier they will be.
Brush melted butter over the tops of smashed potatoes. Season with salt, garlic powder, and pepper.
Place potatoes in the basket of the air fryer in an even layer; cook until golden and crisp, about 10 minutes. Garnish with parsley and serve hot.
e0b18245413eacb745a6e04b.title: Air Fryer Smashed Potatoes

e145bfa9f8a1569f8293fc60.author: Carrie Havranek
e145bfa9f8a1569f8293fc60.title: How to Make Crispy Air Fryer French Fries

instructions: Preheat the Air Fryer to 380 degrees Fahrenheit. Prepare the basket with olive oil, avocado oil spray, or nonstick cooking spray.

Place the eggs in a small bowl and whisk, and then combine with buttermilk. Add the ground black pepper, salt, and all purpose flour to a rimmed shallow bowl. Add the breadcrumbs and cornmeal mixture to a third bowl.
Use a cutting board and a sharp knife to carefully slice the green tomatoes into 1/4 inch rounds.
Create a dipping station assembly line and dip tomato slices into the flour mixture, then the egg mixture, and then into the breadcrumb and cornmeal mixture.
Place the breaded green tomato slices into a single layer in the air fryer basket. Spray the tops with oil before cooking.
Air fry the breaded green tomatoes using the air fryer setting for 10 to 12 minutes, rotating them halfway through the cooking process and spraying the tops again after flipping.
When finished, the fried green tomatoes should have a crispy coating and be a beautiful golden brown color.
Serve with ranch dressing or your favorite sauce.
e15721b291bd05d1ce6ac53f.title: Air Fryer Fried Green Tomatoes

e1f2e108f8776b94e1319534.author: Pat Bernitt
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 380 degrees F (193 degrees C). Spray the fryer basket with cooking spray or use an air fryer disposable parchment liner.

Place brats in the air fryer basket, being sure not to overcrowd, leaving some room around them. Cook until browned, flipping halfway through cooking time, 12 to 15 minutes. An instant-read thermometer inserted near the center should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).
e1f2e108f8776b94e1319534.title: Air Fryer Brats

instructions: Preheat the Air Fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Place the frozen chicken nuggets in the Air Fryer basket in a single layer, spreading the nuggets to where they are not touching.
Air Fry at 400 degrees for 8 minutes, Flip the chicken nuggets over and continue to cook for an additional 2-4 minutes or until the nuggets are fully cooked and slightly crispy on the outside.
Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
e2297b0325d255f425837214.title: Air Fryer Frozen Chicken Nuggets

e22e7ea5467a37c0f3e9f94c.author: Jen
instructions: Lay tortillas flat, and then spoon about 2 tablespoons of filling across the center of the tortilla. Roll tightly.
Brush the rolled taquito with melted butter.
Place in the air fryer basket, seam side down, without stacking or overlapping.
Air fry at 350 degrees F for 9-11 minutes, until the taquito is golden and crispy.
One can makes about 6 taquitos. Don’t overfill-you should be able to roll it tightly.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve.
e22e7ea5467a37c0f3e9f94c.title: Air Fryer Cherry Pie Taquitos

instructions: Spread the cottage cheese evenly over the sourdough bread.
Sprinkle with red pepper flakes.
Drizzle with honey.
Place into the air fryer basket.
Air fry at 400°F for 8 minutes.
Serve immediately.
e2951196784065af8d586df2.title: Air Fryer cottage cheese toast

e2c36087dcc91603b383f2ba.author: Jen
instructions: Rinse the chicken thighs and pat them dry with a paper towel.
Place chicken thighs into a resealable bag. Top with canola oil and seasonings and seal the bag.
Toss the bag until the thighs are completely covered with the seasonings and oil.
Place the chicken thighs into a single layer in the air fryer basket.
Air fry at 380 degrees Fahrenheit for 13-15 minutes, or until golden brown and juicy with an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Top with fresh chopped parsley before serving.
e2c36087dcc91603b383f2ba.title: Air Fryer Boneless Chicken Thighs

e38e524914998eb76df3f361.author: Becky
instructions: Place sausages in the air fryer basket.
Air fry at 380 degrees F for 10-12 minutes, turning links halfway through air frying time.
These chicken sausage links are delicious as a side to scrambled eggs, or other breakfast items. They can also be cut into slices and tossed with onions and bell peppers.
e38e524914998eb76df3f361.title: Air Fryer Chicken Sausage

e430c07119daed4c6440f14a.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat the Air Fryer to 400º degrees Fahrenheit.
In a microwave safe dish, melt the butter. Then in a large bowl, whisk together the hot sauce and melted butter. Set aside.
Cut cauliflower florets into 1 1/2-2 inch pieces. Toss the cauliflower florets into the hot sauce mixture. Be sure to completely coat all of the pieces with the sauce. Drain the remaining sauce.
In a separate medium bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, garlic powder, and black pepper.
Add the flour mixture to the florets, and toss together until they are well coated with the flour and seasoning mixture.
Transfer the cauliflower florets into the Air Fryer basket and air fry at 400 degrees F for 16-20 minutes, tossing every 4-5 minutes.
Serve cooked cauliflower with your favorite blue cheese or ranch dressing.
e430c07119daed4c6440f14a.title: Air Fryer Buffalo Cauliflower

e4817a0be6e62fc1926bca29.author: Becky
instructions: Remove pie crust from the package. Unroll it onto a flat surface, such as a larger cutting board or clean kitchen counter.

Using a pastry cutter or sharp paring knife, cut the crust into small circles, about 6 inches in size. Then reroll the scraps of pie crust into a flat layer using a rolling pin and cut additional circles until all of the crust is used.

Place each 6-inch circle on a baking sheet. Spoon apple pie filling onto the center of one side of each crust circle (leaving space for edges). Once they are all filled, fold the crust over and pinch or use a fork to seal edges.

In a small bowl, whisk the egg and milk to make the egg wash. Then in another small dish, combine the sugar and ground cinnamon together. Brush pies with egg wash mixture onto the top of each pie and then sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon, or just coarse sugar.
Spray the air fryer basket with nonstick spray or line with air fryer parchment paper liners. Air fry at 380 degrees F for 6 minutes, turning pies halfway through cooking process.
Let them rest for a few minutes on a baking rack and then serve hot, warm or room temperature.
e4817a0be6e62fc1926bca29.title: Air Fryer Apple Hand Pies

e5aa0365e2768dd58212ac11.author: Becky
ingredients: 4  English muffins (sliced in half, making 8 pieces)
Optional Toppings: Such as pepperoni, mushrooms, ham, pineapple, olives, onions
instructions: Air frying four muffin halves at a time, place muffins in the air fryer, cut side up. Air fry at 380 degrees F for 2-4 minutes, until slightly crispy.
Remove muffins from the air fryer. Spread about one tablespoon of sauce onto each muffin. Top with cheese and preferred toppings.
Return to the air fryer basket and air fry again at 380 degrees F for 3-5 minutes, until the cheese melts.
e5aa0365e2768dd58212ac11.title: Air Fryer English Muffin Pizzas

e5e6bfcc6470f1533fcfbd78.author: Nicole McLaughlin
ingredients: 3 Tablespoons Balsamic vinaigrette or italian dressing
instructions: Place pork, balsamic, soy sauce, honey, Dijon mustard, Worcestershire, olive oil, onion powder, garlic powder, and black pepper in a large zip lock bag.Seal bag and massage mixture around the meat until well combined and coated. Refrigerate at least 4 hours and up to 2 days.
Remove pork from marinade and discard marinade. Sprinkle tenderloins with salt.

Heat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Lightly coat air fryer basket with cooking spray or use an air fryer liner. Add pork tenderloins and cook 20 minutes, flipping halfway through. Let rest for 5 to 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
e5e6bfcc6470f1533fcfbd78.title: Best Air Fryer Pork Tenderloin

e6bc7b93dea504b8d8ec6509.author: Jen
instructions: Carefully cut the carrots lengthwise into 1/4 inch wide fries.
Toss the carrot sticks in a large bowl with olive oil, garlic powder, sea salt, and ground black pepper until fully coated
Place the seasoned carrots into the Air Fryer basket in a single layer and cook at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes.
Shake and flip the fries, and then cook an additional 5-10 minutes or until crispy and tender on the inside.
Serve with your favorite dipping sauce!
e6bc7b93dea504b8d8ec6509.title: Air Fryer Carrot Fries

e85a7c5b896a00fb9fb5a4b5.author: Allrecipes Member
e85a7c5b896a00fb9fb5a4b5.title: Air Fryer Lobster Tails with Lemon-Garlic Butter

e86db36b24831a3d934a0c06.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat the Air Fryer to 400 degrees F. Prepare the air fryer basket with nonstick cooking spray or olive oil spray.
Add the seasonings to a small bowl and set it aside.
Take the clean and dry chicken breasts and rub both sides evenly with the seasoning rub.
Wrap each chicken breast with 2 pieces of bacon, trying to keep the ends of the bacon underneath the chicken breast.
Place the bacon-wrapped chicken breasts into the bottom of the prepared air fryer basket.

Air Fry the chicken at 400 degrees F for 15 minutes, then turn down the temperature to 370 degrees F for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the internal temperature has reached 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Serve immediately with your favorite sides.
e86db36b24831a3d934a0c06.title: Air Fryer Bacon Wrapped Chicken

e8c3644d7ea919c53df89b38.author: bdweld
ingredients: 1.5 (16 ounce) jars spicy dill pickle spears
instructions: Combine flour and paprika in a bowl. Whisk milk and beaten egg together in a second bowl. Place panko in a third bowl.
Heat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C) according to the manufacturer's instructions.

Dredge one pickle spear in flour mixture; shake off excess. Dip into egg mixture to coat, then lift up so excess egg drips back into the bowl. Press into panko to thoroughly coat. Place breaded pickle, unstacked, onto a plate. Repeat to bread remaining pickles.
Spray breaded pickles lightly with cooking spray, then place into the air fryer basket in a single layer, working in batches if necessary to avoid overcrowding the fryer.
Cook in the preheated air fryer until panko is golden brown, about 14 minutes, turning halfway through.
e8c3644d7ea919c53df89b38.title: Air Fryer Spicy Dill Pickle Fries

e8fff3781b7a7674dc567d07.author: Becky
instructions: Using a stand mixer, or a large bowl, combine the brownie mix, eggs, oil, and flour. Beat ingredients together until it forms a fudgy batter.
Add holiday candies, such as red and green M and M's to the batter. Stir until they are evenly distributed throughout the batter.
Use a spoon, or portion scoop to drop dough onto the parchment paper lining the air fryer basket. Leave about 1 inch between dough for cookies to spread.
Air Fry at  370 degrees F for  6-8 minutes. Let cookies set in the basket for 2-3 minutes before removing.
e8fff3781b7a7674dc567d07.title: Air Fryer Christmas Brownie Mix Cookies

e9a64150ad0c9c1017b87ed9.author: Becky
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the cereals, mixed nuts, and pretzels. Then set the bowl aside.

In a small bowl, combine the melted butter, Worcestershire sauce, and garlic powder. Pour the butter mixture over cereal mix. Toss all of the ingredients together, completely coating the cereal mixture.
Pour the Chex Mix in a single layer into the air fryer basket. Work in batches if necessary.
Air Fry at 250 degrees F for 10 minutes, shaking the basket or stirring the mixture, halfway through the cooking time.
Once it is done, lay it out on a baking sheet to cool.
e9a64150ad0c9c1017b87ed9.title: Air Fryer Chex Mix

ec5594ce2b473d9b340a6d03.author: Becky
instructions: Cut broccoli before air frying, slice the broccoli head and cut broccoli florets, medium to small in sized pieces, removing the core.
Place florets in a large bowl. Add the olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Toss the broccoli until it is coated with the oil and Seasonings.
Transfer the seasoned broccoli to basket, in a single layer, work in batches if necessary.
Air fry broccoli at 400° Fahrenheit for 5-7 minutes, shake air fryer basket halfway through cooking, and cook until broccoli reaches your the crisp you desire.
ec5594ce2b473d9b340a6d03.title: Air Fryer Broccoli

ed5928d30d8423efb3541e02.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 400 degrees F.
Create a dredging station with the egg and milk, flour mixture and seasoned breadcrumbs.
Place flour in a shallow dish. Set flour aside.
In a separate shallow dish whisk the egg and milk together. Set milk mixture aside.
In a third separate bowl combine panko, salt, pepper, paprika, and garlic powder together. Set breadcrumb mixture aside.
Rinse the calamari with cold water.
Then pat the calamari rings dry with a paper towel before dipping to remove excess water.
Dip calamari rings in flour (shake off excess flour), then into the egg mixture, and finally in the seasoned panko mixture.
Place the calamari rings in a single layer into the air fryer basket. Place extra rings on a baking sheet if working in batches.
Spray tops of rings with nonstick cooking spray.

Air fry at 400 degrees F for 4 minutes. Flip rings at this point in the cooking process then spray tops with olive oil cooking spray. Continue to air fry for an additional 2-3 minutes or until golden brown and have crispy calamari.
If using frozen calamari rings, you may need to add 2-4 minutes of additional cook time. Do not overcook or you will get tough calamari.
Place calamari on a wire rack so they remain crispy.  Add a sprinkle of salt and black pepper as soon as they are removed from the air fryer.
ed5928d30d8423efb3541e02.title: Air Fryer Calamari

edf90d2100d9a8d4c54fd812.author: Becky
ingredients: 2 cups broccoli florets (cut into bite size pieces)
2 cups cauliflower florets (cut into bite size pieces)
instructions: In a large bowl, add fresh broccoli and fresh cauliflower.
Then add in olive oil, garlic powder, and salt, tossing together until vegetables are well coated.
Spray olive oil spray into the basket to make sure vegetables get crispier edges and do not stick.
Pour vegetables into the air fryer basket. Air fry at 380 degrees F for 8-10 minutes until the vegetables have crisp edges and are golden brown.
Toss or shake the basket halfway through the cooking process.
Serve while hot.
edf90d2100d9a8d4c54fd812.title: Air Fryer Broccoli and Cauliflower

ee1e68ab444f4686098b4bf3.author: Yoly
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 380 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Spread 1/2 teaspoon butter on each slice of bread. Place 1 slice of bread, butter side down in the air fryer. Top with 2 slices cheese. Place 2nd slice of bread, butter side up, over cheese.
Air-fry until golden brown, 3 to 4 minutes. Flip sandwich over and air-fry an additional 1 to 2 minutes.
ee1e68ab444f4686098b4bf3.title: Air Fryer Grilled Cheese

eec881f79d8ab8259e681c16.author: Becky
instructions: Prepare the basket of your airfryer by placing a piece of parchment paper in the bottom. Poke holes in the paper for air flow.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cake mix, oil, and eggs. Mix until all of the ingredients are combined and it is a thick dough.
If using baking chips, candies, sprinkles, or nuts, stir them into the dough, until they are evenly distributed.

Use a small scoop or spoon and drop scoops of dough into the prepared basket of your air fryer. Be sure to allow room for the dough to slightly spread. Work in batches and do not let the dough touch or overlap.
Cook at 370 degrees Fahrenheit for four minutes per batch.
eec881f79d8ab8259e681c16.title: Air Fryer Cake Mix Cookies

eef1e95828684e89d2ee74bb.author: Becky
instructions: Peel, rinse, and then cut the potatoes into 1 inch cubes, about the size of dice.
Using a large mixing bowl, toss the cubed potatoes in olive oil and then the seasonings, until they are well coated.
Place the seasoned potatoes in the air fryer basket, and air fry at 400 degrees F for 20 minutes, shaking the basket halfway through the cooking time.
The potatoes should be golden brown and crispy when done.
Serve while hot.
eef1e95828684e89d2ee74bb.title: Air Fryer Breakfast Potatoes

ef56550d99bc5066ad8687e6.author: Becky
instructions: Rinse, and then slice jalapenos in half, lengthwise. Remove membrane and seeds.
In a small bowl, stir together cream cheese, cheddar cheese, and seasonings. Fill slices of jalapeno with cheese mixture, and then place slices together, making a whole pepper.

Carefully slice each piece of chicken in half, without cutting all the way through. Place chicken in a ziplock bag or wrapped in saran wrap, and pound or roll with a rolling pin, until thin, then cut in half, making four flattened pieces of chicken.
Place stuffed jalapeno at the end of the flattened chicken breast and then roll chicken. Repeat with remaining pieces of chicken.
Wrap each rolled piece of chicken with 2-4 slices of bacon, covering the entire piece. Use toothpicks if necessary to hold bacon in place while air frying.
Place poppers in the air fryer basket and air fry at 370 for 10-12 minutes, until bacon is crispy.
Use a meat thermometer to confirm the internal temperature of chicken is 165 degrees. Add 2-3 minutes cooking time if necessary.
ef56550d99bc5066ad8687e6.title: Chicken Jalapeno Poppers

f18ae2419fd93e1578076f5e.author: Becky
instructions: Lay tortillas flat, and then spoon about 2 tablespoons of filling across the center of the tortilla.
Roll tightly and then brush the rolled taquito with melted butter.
In a shallow, flat dish, stir together the sugar and cinnamon, then roll the buttered taquito in the mixture, coating the outside.
Place in the air fryer basket, seam side down, without stacking or overlapping.
Air fry at 350 degrees F for 9-11 minutes, until the taquito is golden and crispy.
Use tongs to flip them over, and air fry for an additional 3-4 minutes, or until they reach your desired crispness.
f18ae2419fd93e1578076f5e.title: Air Fryer Apple Pie Taquitos

f1c9adb9cb17d973b5594fd6.author: Jen
instructions: Rinse and dry chicken breasts. Cut each chicken breast into 2 inch cubes. Set aside.
Whisk the eggs together in a small bowl. Add flour to a small plate.
Combine the panko breadcrumbs and seasonings in a small plate.
Take chicken pieces and dip them into the flour, then into the egg, and then into the seasoned breadcrumbs, covering each piece of chicken.
Add the seasoned coated chicken to the basket of the air fryer in an even layer, keeping space between the chicken.
Spray the chicken wings with a light coat of avocado oil.
Air fry the chicken at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 15-17 minutes, tossing the wings halfway through.
Sauce: Top with your favorite homemade wing sauce or with your favorite brand.
f1c9adb9cb17d973b5594fd6.title: Air Fryer Boneless Wings

f793cbfd1bd4c09953498228.author: Becky
instructions: To make this recipe, begin by unrolling and separating each crescent roll.
In a small microwave safe bowl, melt the butter. Then, stir in the cinnamon and granulated sugar until butter mixture thickens into a paste.
Spread the cinnamon-sugar mixture on top of each crescent roll and then roll in a crescent shape.
Spray the Air Fryer basket with nonstick cooking spray or line with Air Fryer parchment paper. Place rolls in air fryer basket, leaving a small space between each pastry.
Air fry at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for about 5-7 minutes until crescent rolls are golden brown. Add additional cooking time if necessary, depending on the size of your Air Fryer.
Carefully remove cooked rolls from the Air Fryer. Sprinkle with powdered sugar, drizzle with melted chocolate or frosting glaze, or top with cream cheese frosting.
f793cbfd1bd4c09953498228.title: Air Fryer Cinnamon Crescent Rolls

f88755d88177b2ea0488116c.author: Elle
instructions: Preheat an air fryer to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) according to manufacturer's instructions. Line the air fryer basket with parchment paper.
Combine mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese, egg, and garlic powder in a bowl until well mixed. Press into a circle on the parchment in the basket.
Air-fry for 10 minutes. Serve warm, but not hot.
f88755d88177b2ea0488116c.title: Air Fryer Keto Garlic Cheese 'Bread'

f89a254737bdebb0fbf98bf5.author: lutzflcat
ingredients: 1 (13.8 ounce) package refrigerated pizza dough (such as Pillsbury®)
sprinkle of dried basil and red pepper flakes (optional)
instructions: Preheat the air fryer for 5 minutes at 380 degrees F (190 degrees C). Spray the air fryer basket with olive oil spray or line with a parchment liner to avoid sticking.

Remove crust from the can, and cut in half. Shape each piece of dough into a circle and crimping up the edges to form a crust. Make sure it’ll fit in your air fryer basket. Carefully transfer one pizza crust to the air fryer basket and spray lightly with olive oil spray. Prick the dough with a fork and precook for 3 minutes.

Spread 3 tablespoons pizza sauce onto the crust in the air fryer basket and sprinkle with 1/2 of the mozzarella cheese. Top with 7 pepperoni slices and half of the onion slices. Sprinkle with basil and red pepper flakes, if using.

Cook until crust is golden brown and crispy and the cheese has melted, 7 to 9 minutes. Keep in mind that cooking times may vary depending on the brand and size of your air fryer, so check frequently to be sure nothing overcooks or burns. Repeat procedure with the second pizza crust. Serve hot.
f89a254737bdebb0fbf98bf5.title: Air Fryer Pizza

f8d8d229f7215ba40f0804ca.author: Brooke Caison
f8d8d229f7215ba40f0804ca.title: Air Fryer Cacio E Pepe Arancini

f959158709c24a545702e151.author: Bibi
f959158709c24a545702e151.title: Air Fryer Butternut Squash Home Fries

fadf62f020421a8f04b5039c.author: Becky
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 350 degrees F.
Open the package of rolls and then transfer the rolls to the air fryer basket. Arrange them so there is space in between, without stacking, touching, or overlapping. Work in batches if necessary.
If you haven't already, melt the butter in a microwave safe bowl for 15-30 seconds. Then, brush the tops of the rolls with the melted butter.
Air fry at 350 degrees for 5-8 minutes, until the rolls are light golden brown. Flip the rolls for the last two minutes. Serve while warm.
fadf62f020421a8f04b5039c.title: Air Fryer Frozen Dinner Rolls

fb2be445c2612b7a5f7c0051.author: Jen
instructions: Place frozen burgers in a single layer in the basket of the air fryer.
Air fry the burgers at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 15 minutes, flipping the burgers halfway through cook time.
If desired, add sliced cheese during the last minute of cooking time.
Carefully remove the burgers from the air fryer and serve them with your favorite toppings.
fb2be445c2612b7a5f7c0051.title: Air Fryer Frozen Burger

fbdad558af00a732d6e78aad.author: Jen
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken breasts (cut into 2-inch cubes)
1 medium red onion (sliced and cut into small squares)
1 medium red bell pepper (sliced and cut into small squares)
1 medium yellow bell pepper (sliced and cut into small squares)
instructions: Cut wooden skewers to fit into the air fryer if needed.
Soak the skewers in water for 20 minutes before air frying.
In a medium bowl, combine the chicken and taco seasoning until each piece is equally coated. Create a working station with the vegetables and chicken.
For each skewer, add onion, bell peppers, and chicken, and rotate them as desired. Place the chicken kabobs in the air fryer basket in a single layer.
Air fryer chicken kabobs at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 18 minutes, flipping the skewers halfway through the cook time.
fbdad558af00a732d6e78aad.title: Air Fryer Chicken Kabobs

fd4a662bd04d116e99f9162b.author: Jen
instructions: Open the canned cinnamon rolls, remove the icing to a small bowl, and set it aside.
Use a knife to cut the cinnamon rolls into equal pieces. Take each piece of cinnamon roll and hand roll it until they are small round dough balls.
Place the cinnamon roll bites in a single layer into the prepared basket of the air fryer.
Air fry cinnamon rolls at 320 degrees Fahrenheit for 6 minutes or until golden brown, flipping the bites halfway through.
Carefully remove the cinnamon roll bites from the air fryer basket and serve with the icing as a dipping sauce.
fd4a662bd04d116e99f9162b.title: Air Fryer Cinnamon Roll Bites

fd7aa6739e214c3f2ffa9cc9.author: Jen
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 390 degrees Fahrenheit and prepare the air fryer basket.
Wash and clean the sweet potatoes.
Cover the sweet potatoes with the olive oil. Take afork and lightly prick the skin all over for each of the sweet potatoes.
Cover the sweet potatoes with kosher salt.
Place the sweet potatoes in a single layer in the basket of the air fryer. Cook on 390 degrees Fahrenheit for 40-45 minutes.
Carefully remove the sweet potatoes from the air fryer basket.
Slice open the sweet cooked potatoes, fluff the sweet potato flesh, and top with butter, cinnamon, and brown sugar. Serve.
fd7aa6739e214c3f2ffa9cc9.title: Air Fryer Baked Sweet Potatoes

fdd67f7e92f33cdfd41f337f.author: France Cevallos
fdd67f7e92f33cdfd41f337f.title: Air Fryer Prosciutto and Mozzarella Grilled Cheese

fdfe67c546152042902b6aa4.author: FrackFamily5 CACT
instructions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat an air fryer to 390 degrees F (200 degrees C) for 15 minutes according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Meanwhile, trim Brussels sprouts. Place in a bowl. Add olive oil, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper; toss well.
Spread sprouts evenly in the air fryer basket.
Cook in the preheated air fryer for 15 minutes, checking and shaking the basket halfway through the cycle.
Serve and enjoy!
fdfe67c546152042902b6aa4.title: Simple Air Fryer Brussels Sprouts

instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 375°F (190°C) for 3 minutes to ensure a uniform cooking environment.
Arrange the frozen shrimp tempura in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Avoid overlapping to ensure each piece cooks evenly.
Air fry at 375°F (190°C) for 8 minutes, flipping the shrimp halfway through to ensure they get crispy on all sides.

instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 5 minutes.
Place bananas on a cutting board and slice the bananas into thin slices, about 1⁄4 inch thick.
Put the sliced bananas in a medium bowl and gently toss them in the olive oil. Mix until evenly coated.
Place raw banana slices in a single layer in the basket of the air fryer. Do not overfill air fryer with bananas.
Air fry banana chips for 8-10 minutes at 350 degrees F, flipping halfway through the cooking process. Until the bananas are lightly browned and crispy.
Remove them from the air fryer and place them on a wire rack. Sprinkle with a little salt and let chips cool.
Continue cooking bananas in batches until completely finished.

instructions: Mix the chicken, breadcrumbs, paremsan cheese, egg, and seasoning in a small mixing bowl.
Prepare the air fryer basket with a piece of parchment paper or nonstick cooking spray.
Roll the chicken mixture into nine 2" meatballs.
Place the meatballs onto the prepared Air Fryer basket in a single layer, leaving room in between the meatballs. (Do not preheat the air fryer for this recipe.)

Cook on 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 12 minutes, flipping the meatballs halfway through. Add marinara sauce on top of each chicken meatball and then top with mozzarella cheese. Cook on 350 for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve over noodles, in a hoagie bun, on sliders, or as an appetizer.

instructions: Preheat your Air Fryer to 370°F (188°C) to ensure a quick start to cooking.

Prepare your dipping station by placing Italian breadcrumbs, flour mixed with black pepper, garlic powder, and sea salt in one rimmed dish, and panko breadcrumbs in another. Place the beaten egg in a seperate small bowl.

Start by rolling an avocado slice in the flour mixture, tapping off excess. Dip the flour-coated slice into the egg, then into the Italian breadcrumb mixture, and finally coat it generously with the panko breadcrumbs.
Spray the air fryer basket with avocado oil to prevent sticking. Arrange the breaded avocado slices in a single layer in the basket, ensuring there is space between each for air circulation.
Spray the avocado slices lightly with more avocado oil. Cook at 370°F (188°C) for 7-8 minutes, flipping the fries halfway through to ensure even crisping.

instructions: Preheat your air fryer to 400°F (200°C) for 3 minutes. Prepare the air fryer basket with nonstick spray.
Partially cook the bacon in the air fryer for 3 minutes, flipping halfway through. Remove and let cool on a paper towel.

Prepare the scallops by removing the side muscle and patting them dry. Wrap each scallop with a slice of bacon and secure with a toothpick. Lightly spray the scallops with olive oil and season with black pepper and Old Bay seasoning.
Place them in a single layer in the air fryer basket.
Cook for 8 minutes, turning halfway, until the scallops are tender and opaque, and the bacon is crispy.
Serve hot and enjoy the combination of juicy scallops with crispy bacon.

instructions: Cut block of tofu in half vertically and set side by side on a plate lined with multiple layers of paper towels. Add a thick layer of paper towels on top, weigh down with a heavy object (I used my bread box) and press for 30 minutes to remove as much liquid as possible.
Cut tofu into 1-inch cubes and place in a bowl. Drizzle with soy sauce and carefully toss to coat.

Combine cornstarch, onion powder, paprika, and white pepper in a small bowl. Add to tofu and carefully coat tofu with cornstarch mixture. Drizzle with sesame oil. Place tofu pieces in one layer in the basket of your air fryer. You might need to work in batches.
Air-fry at 390 degrees F (200 degrees C) for 6 minutes. Turn tofu pieces over and air-fry until crispy, about 6 more minutes.
